notes.title: Pre-Release Update v0.6.5
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/cdf38181dadb3d0e98ebc8b3756ec90372e40eda.jpg[/img]

We’ve got a whole new look for the player avatar! Plus Arena crowds, much-requested Life Block sizes, Creature Builder improvements based on your feedback, and more. Patch notes for this latest update are below. As always, bugs are expected in these work-in-progress builds so we really appreciate any bugs reports and feedback you send our way on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/]Pre-Release forum[/url].

* If you’re not familiar with Pre-Release, it’s the unstable developer branch we use for testing new stuff. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/305510202673028167/]More info here.[/url]

[h1][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[b]New Features/Improvements[/b]
[list][*]The player avatar has a new look! Let us know what you think!
[list][*]We wanted the player character to fit in with the direction of our updated art style and proportions. The old avatar stood out as cartoonish and a bit childish so we felt it was important to update it to match the fidelity and realism of the new environment and creatures. We also wanted to make sure it felt like a proper adventurer as you and your creatures explore the world of CHKN.[/list][/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/bfd20741a20399a4d2190e8a4b146b37a6991219.jpg[/img]
[i]Old vs New. Off to adventure![/i]
[list][list][*]So, we aged it up and raised the camera higher off the ground, reworked the proportions to fit within the game and look better next to the new creatures and environments, made it gender neutral so you can tell your own story, increased the detail while still keeping it optimized, and gave it proper newbie adventuring garb.[/list][/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/8b07f72a3be4f7d9219cce5ef2b8d38f4f71379f.gif[/img]
[i]Come, Dochickat! We have trees to chop and death to thwart![/i]
[list][list][*]And, of course, all the animations have been updated too! Run, roll, jump, and pet your way through the world.[/list][/list]
https://youtu.be/nUAev3SQxSI[list][list][*]NOTE: Using old armor sets will turn your character back into the old avatar for now. We’re working on new armor sets soon.
[*]The baddies of CHKN will need an update as well, so expect a revamped Poacher soon.[/list][/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/91c3fb5e2b4bca9d02d8908a9e963ee8747d48e2.jpg[/img]
[i]How It’s Made: Avatar Edition. Much digital sewing is required to get the new adventuring gear just right.[/i]
[list][*]Arena battles now have an audience!
[list][*]We’ve added creature/avatar spectators and crowd sounds to cheer your creatures on.
[*]Arena ring art has been polished up and new team member support banners added.[/list][/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/fbf243bb40a3577ded4ed38588093c84f1d92e5e.jpg[/img]
[i]Pay no attention to crazy zombie chicken spectators. They’re just here to enjoy the show.[/i]
[list][*]Improved progress saves:
[list][*]Take your Adventure Mode progress with you into Multiplayer games, so you don’t have to start over with new creatures and inventory. 
[*]Whatever items/creatures you have when you exit that Multiplayer game comes back with you to your Adventure.[/list]
[*]New Creature Builder improvements based on community feedback:
[list][*]Light tutorial added to help first-time builders[/list][/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/37d4287dcbe2eae37c69ce540e86bdc882097ca5.jpg[/img]
[i]Prompts at the top and highlighted guides help you build your first creature: an adorable baby chicken.[/i]
[list][list][*]“Creature Front” arrow graphic changed to be less intrusive when building
[*]See a preview of stat changes while placing additional Life Blocks on a creature[/list][/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/505bf77cabef6fe9f9e3d562ebf80f60917215ea.jpg[/img]
[i]Green shows stat increases. Red shows decreases. Placement also matters! Try different positions to see how the creature’s stats are affected.[/i]
[*]Life Blocks:
[list][*]New half-sized chicken blocks added for more variety and creative opportunities in your creature designs
[*]Life Block naming made consistent (which also makes ordering of the Life Blocks in the Creature Builder more consistent and easier to find)
[*]Missing Life Block icons added[/list]
[*]Stats are better balanced for more challenging survival:
[list][*]Creature stat formulas changed to have diminishing returns
[*]Life Block stats, item stats, and ability values have been tuned for balance
[*]Creature defense now shows average defense amongst damage types (rather than total) to give you a better overall comparison[/list]
[*]Improved UI:
[list][*]You can now access inventory and other tabs while using the Creature Builder
[*]You can now add/edit descriptions for your Bonded creatures on the Party screen
[*]New achievements are in progress (You’ll see some achievement tracking notices pop up in the UI. We’ll hook these up to Steam once we’re tracking)[/list]
[*]Tech:
[list][*]Upgraded to latest version of Unity engine (for bug fixes, new development features, and better performance)[/list][/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Multiplayer fixes:
[list][*]Active scene synced on multiplayer games
[*]World data syncing issues solved on first connect
[*]Static objects display correctly in multiplayer
[*]Trees now animate when being struck in multiplayer games
[*]Trees now fall over for clients when broken in multiplayer games[/list]
[*]Creature thumbnail image generation fixed
[*]Infinite loop caused by creature flinch animations fixed
[*]Bad polygons fixed for the snake mouth
[*]Creature builder root assignment bug fixes
[*]Creature leg offsetting corrected[/list]
[h1][b]Quick links for testers:[/b][/h1]
[list][*]If you want to see what’s new on Pre-Release, here are the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/305510202673028167/]instructions[/url]
[*]Please post your bugs and feedback [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/]on our forums[/url]
[*]You can also join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/xaeqGp8]CHKN discord[/url] to post bugs, feedback, or questions (or just hang out!)[/list]
Thanks for all your testing help, everyone! We hope you like these latest updates. Our next Pre-Release update is coming in about 2 weeks and will be all about Adventure Mode survival.

[i]- Team CHKN[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/420930/CHKN/

notes.title: Pre-Release Update v0.6.4
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/bbe4b078a7b25a9449f50bfe7935fea927340eaf.gif[/img]
Happy Tuesday, everyone! Here’s a list of patch notes for the latest Pre-Release update. Bugs are always expected in these work-in-progress builds so we could really use your help testing! We appreciate any bug reports and feedback you send our way on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/]Pre-Release forum[/url].

* If you’re not familiar with Pre-Release, it’s the unstable developer branch we use for testing new stuff. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/305510202673028167/]More info here.[/url]

[h1][b]Patch Notes [Pre-Release v0.6.4][/b][/h1]

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list][*]New Arena Mode - Exhibition Match:
[list][*]Now there are two ways to play the Arena. In Exhibition Mode, battle creatures in 1 vs 1 matches. First to score 3 points wins! Play in spectator mode (CPU vs CPU) if you want to watch the action, or Player vs CPU if you want to control a creature directly in battle. Points are awarded by scoring a knockdown or by how well a creature did offensively before the round time ends. 
[*]Added in this “Exhibition” arena mode release:
[list][*]Knockdowns trigger a snazzy slow down moment.
[*]In the “corners” between rounds, apply bandages and feed to prepare for the next round.
[*]New Arena art and sounds of crowds[/list][/list][/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/1fd7964a3a2a8903c145b3facca9f2501cf9e7f3.gif[/img]
[list][*]Automated Cameras in Arena modes
[list][*]Cameras will now automatically follow the creatures and capture all the action (when you’re not directly controlling a creature). If you want to control the camera yourself, launch a game in Elimination Mode.[/list]
[*]Dev Console Added - Helpful for bug reports
[list][*]This new console replaces the / (slash) commands previously used in the chat window.
[*]Press ` (accent) to access the dev console.
[*]Use /help to view all available commands.
[*]You can now output logs directly from console, which is especially useful when sending us bug reports. Use the /savetxt command and find your file in your CHKN directory. (Usually in C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\CHKN\ on Windows.)[/list][/list]
[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list][*]Many creature building improvements[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/28781111ddf78ffc0dfbb044b34a29d5f1b7b342.jpg[/img]
[list][list][*]Click to select block/place is back, in addition to the existing drag & drop mode.
[*]Lock mode added that lets you repeatedly reuse a selected block.
[list][*]When toggled on, whatever block you currently have selected in the Life Block tray can be used repeatedly, without re-selecting it each time.
[*]Toggle it off to clear the selection and allow for manipulating blocks already placed on the creature.[/list]
[*]Traits added. Traits are automatically granted based off how a creature is built.
[*]Undo/Redo functionality improved
[*]Builder UI simplified and cleaned up (better creature filtering selection, clearer Life Block tooltips, consolidated tool buttons, improved block highlighting, cleaner abilities browsing/selecting, etc.)
[*]Code stabilized and many bugs squashed
[*]Block/Block chain rotation fixes
[*]Bug fixes with interacting with root block[/list]
[*]Creature animation system updates
[list][*]Fixes to bounds issues, strikes, block separation, leg bends, creature look direction, root identification for certain block configurations
[*]Animation smoothing improvements
[*]Creature flinching functional again[/list]
[*]Creature block changes
[list][*]Added icons for updated creature Life Blocks. (There are still a few missing that we’ll add on the next pass.)
[*]Half-sized crab blocks added (will be adding more in the future)
[*]Fixes to leg animations, snake texturing, highlight materials
[*]Fur visual improved[/list]
[*]Crafting/Character screens overhauled... again!
[list][*]UX made consistent, fullscreen UI, and cleaned up look
[*]Many bugs squashed
[*]Unneeded features have been removed[/list][/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/ae8bf1fa3052321db963ffee125a01ddfc6cac1e.jpg[/img]
[i]New fullscreen character/inventory tab.[/i]
[list][*]UI overhaul (in progress)
[list][*]Changing all screens to work in fullscreen for all aspect ratios. 
[*]Creatures in UI now animate and can be rotated with the mouse
[*]Compare creature power with a new stats radar graphic.
[list][*]Stats themselves are still being adjusted. Once we’ve standardized this, the radar will become more clear.[/list]
[*]Arena mode selection and options now broken into its own flow[/list][/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/09b2ab1ab460166a93f488b6c930b9d7cc5174a7.gif[/img]
[i]New fullscreen, animated Arena creature selection! Some creatures are angrier than others.[/i]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list][*]Pathfinding fixes. Creatures should no longer walk through walls.
[*]Dog buffs now properly increase stats.
[*]Electric shock ability now uses energy.
[*]Multiplayer world syncing improved (trees/bushes) in Creative Mode. NOTE: Initial connect is still buggy. You may have to try multiple times.[/list]
[h1][b]Quick links for testers:[/b][/h1]
[list][*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/305510202673028167/]Instructions[/url] for how to get on Pre-Release
[*]Please post your bugs and feedback [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/]on our forums[/url]
[*]You can also join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/xaeqGp8]CHKN discord[/url] to post bugs, feedback, or questions (or just hang out!)[/list]
Thank you for helping us test these updates! We hope you like them.

[i]- Team CHKN[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/420930/CHKN/

notes.title: Pre-Release Update v0.6.3
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/4166582e293d150c38cef70bcd317c48cb7d3f2d.jpg[/img]

Hey, everyone. We’ve got patch notes for you for the latest Pre-Release update. Since Pre-Release is work in progress, bugs are expected and we could really use your help testing. We appreciate any bug reports and feedback you send our way on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/]Pre-Release forum[/url].

* If you’re not familiar with Pre-Release, it’s the unstable developer branch we use for testing new stuff. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/305510202673028167/]More info here.[/url]

[h1][b]Patch Notes [Pre-Release v0.6.3][/b][/h1]
[list][*][b]Creature Builder UX Improvements[/b]
[list][*]Toolbars have been removed and all actions are now done by interacting directly with the Life Blocks themselves. No more swapping “tools” as you build! This makes it easier to get Life Blocks exactly where you want them and removes unnecessary complexity. (The UI was getting crowded!) A quick guide:[/list][/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/bf50508aa48b47abfa644c452c4c0f6c5e5c3d4d.jpg[/img]
[list][list][list][*]Add: Drag a Life Block from the tray on the left to your creature (Clicking to add will also be returning soon so you’ll be able to choose your favorite method when building.)
[*]Rotate: Use the [R] key while dragging, or click a Life Block on your creature to select it and then click the rotate button that appears
[*]Move: Click on a Life Block on your creature and drag it around wherever you want it. You can grab single blocks or whole groups.
[*]Remove: Click on a Life Block on your creature to select it, then click the trash can or use the [Del] key. (The block is returned to your inventory in Adventure Mode.)
[*]Camera focus: Now auto-focuses around the Life Block you have selected. No need to refocus manually.[/list]
[*]Tell us what you think of the new system.[/list]
[*][b]New Character & Crafting Journal panels in progress[/b]
[list][*]New item inspection box lets you view stats and other useful info for items in various inventory and crafting panels
[*]New crafting interface
[list][*]Filter recipes using the icons on the left
[*]See all the resources needed at a glance
[*]Queueing added to workstations. Add up to 4 items so the station keeps working while you’re away (as long as your creature can handle the workload!)
[*]Remember that some recipes require workstations to craft, even if you have all the resources. We’ll be adding this info to the UI soon.[/list]
[*]Toolbox now replaces Crafting panel in Creative Mode for easy access to all items in the game
[*]Character panel now includes a spot for some fun adventure stats. (They’re all 0 for now. We’ll be hooking these up in the future.)
[*]More improvements coming as we work on this, including much-needed item stack functionality[/list][/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/ac61fd3901726b159a61fa81c29d4f4290709b99.jpg[/img]
[i]Crafting tools and wooden structures at the Workbench.[/i]
[list][*][b]New Creature Power & Tiers System[/b]
[list][*]A new stat called Creature Power (CP) combines a creature’s stats, abilities, and level to give you an overall estimate of how powerful that creature is.
[*]Compare CPs when you run across a creature in the wild or face a challenger in the Arena to see if the fight will be more evenly matched.
[*]As you build a creature, keep an eye on the new stats breakdown to immediately see how each Life Block you add affects your creature.
[list][*]As more stats and abilities are added to a creature, it moves into higher Build Tiers (replaces the old “build limit” system) and CP increases.
[*]Stats are broken down and color-coded per category: health, energy, attack, defense, movement speed, range, abilities
[*]This new stat breakdown UI helps you strategize your builds and decide what your creature’s strengths and weaknesses are within each Build Tier. You may have to trade speed for health, or a combat ability for a farming one, depending on the type of creature you’re trying to build.
[*]The current bright rainbow stat breakdown will be made much prettier in the future. ;)[/list]
[*]Build Tier limiting is currently disabled in Adventure Mode, meaning creature progression is unbalanced and you’ll be able to make very strong creatures early on in survival. This will be working in a future build.[/list][/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/d34652f43cf4ecc62aab3d48db599262554cc8b8.jpg[/img]
[i]The stats breakdowns of four different creatures. Stat breakdowns change depending the Life Blocks you build with.[/i]
[list][*][b]10 default creature combatants added to the Arena[/b]
[list][*]These creatures are ready for battle so you can jump straight into Arena matches. Pit two of these creatures in the same tier against each other to see how they match up.
[*]These span the tiers and have a range of abilities. They’re a great way to test out the new points and tiers systems before building your own creatures.
[*]Find them in the Discovered tab[/list][/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/301721248a22d7486de103acb493bbf0c006c901.jpg[/img]
[i]Choose two with similar CPs and see who wins![/i]
[list][*][b]Adventure Mode Updates[/b]
[list][*]No more scene load between the temple and open world
[*]Various visual improvements made to the terrain
[*]Initial tutorial area size greatly reduced and quests have been removed for now in preparation for upcoming changes to the on-boarding/tutorial sequence[/list]
[*][b]Creature Art Updates[/b]
[list][*]Texturing improvements to dog, pig, crab, and elephant
[*]Eye shaders fixed
[*]Dog fur improvements
[*]Bad normals/vertices on dog mouth fixed
[*]Leg animation improvements[/list]
[*][b]Creature data optimization[/b]
[list][*]Creature data rewritten to reduce hitches and improve performance as creatures load in the world or when they are edited[/list][/list]
[h1][b]Quick links for testers:[/b][/h1]
[list][*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/305510202673028167/]Instructions[/url] for how to get on Pre-Release
[*]Please post your bugs and feedback [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/]on our forums[/url]
[*]You can also join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/xaeqGp8]CHKN discord[/url] to post bugs, feedback, or questions (or just hang out!)[/list]
[h1][b]Arena Battles Livestream with BrettUltimus[/b][/h1]
Hang out with Brett this [url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=BrettUltimus+CHKN+Arena+Stream+%28twitch.tv%2Fbrettultimus%29&iso=20180724T18&p1=179]Tuesday, July 24th @ 6pm EST[/url] for his next CHKN livestream! He’ll be pitting creatures against each other in epic Arena battles and building new abominations to challenge. Follow [url=https://www.twitch.tv/brettultimus]BrettUltimus on Twitch[/url] and come back on Tuesday to watch the stream.

We’ll see you there!

[i]- Team CHKN[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/420930/CHKN/

notes.title: Pre-Release Update v0.6.2
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/b56ba5dfee0b042a3919653e860906adc0e60f82.gif[/img]

Pre-Release has just been updated with lots of new things for you to test out! (Additional creature revamps, abilities, AI improvements, and more.) As always, we need your feedback! You can post all your thoughts and bugs on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/]Pre-Release feedback forum[/url]. Thank you!

* If you’re not familiar with Pre-Release, it’s the unstable developer branch we use for testing new stuff. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/305510202673028167/]More info here.[/url]

[h1][b]Patch Notes [Pre-Release v0.6.2][/b][/h1]
[list][*]New Abilities:
[list][*]Dog Mouth = Lick Wounds (heal)
[*]Dog block + dog mouth + dog eyes + dog ears (complete dog head) = Dog Barks (buffs and debuffs)
[*]Crab Claw = Claw Punch
[*]Mech dino legs + 50% mech dino blocks = Electric Shock
[*]Cow body + cow legs + cow tail (cow butt!) = Cow Dung (fertilize your farm!)
[*]Cow block + cow mouth + cow eyes + cow ears (complete cow head) = Graze (feeds on grass when it's hungry)[/list]
[*]New Creature Ability Previewer in progress: get more info on abilities, what they do, and what’s required to add them to your creature. You can see the previewer wherever abilities are listed in the game.[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/b380fa78d72c163b8c027b2ad9cf20bc94ae7054.jpg[/img]
[i]Electric Shock = 2 mech dino bodies + 2 mech dino limbs + your creature must be at least 50% mech dino parts overall! A tall order for a powerful ability.[/i]
[list][*]Revamped creature updates in progress! 
[list][*]New blocks: Cow, Elephant, Pig
[*]Spider updated (Note: If you’ve previously built with the new spider legs, you’ll need to update your builds to reconnect the legs.)
[*]Dog textures/shaders updated
[*]Fur material changes for improved furriness
[*]Cat leg notes: front legs animations are a bit wonky at the moment; fix is in progress![/list][/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/e3de63fcf809a537339521b4cd5118396117fbe8.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Environment Updates:
[list][*]Geographical changes to the main Adventure Mode map (after the initial tutorial area) [b]NOTE: This will cause saved Adventure games to get stuck loading! You’ll want to start a new Adventure by creating a new profile on the main menu.[/b]
[*]Art pass on environment pieces of the Tropical Biome [/list][/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/ac3dc6c06bf16c4705d1422553df809ec65d225a.jpg[/img]
[i]A lovely day for pineapples.[/i]
[list][*]AI Improvements:
[list][*]Creatures now jostle for position. They’ll no longer try to not attack straight on when engaged.
[*]All abilities are now triggered more intelligently
[*]Fetch ball mechanic fixed[/list]
[*]Game Launch Fixes:
[list][*]Initial launch time reduced
[*]Memory issues affecting launch have been resolved[/list]
[*]Gameplay Updates:
[list][*]Crafting balance changes
[*]Adventure Mode quest changes
[*]New tools added: New recipes for these items added to the crafting system, plus all new art based on creature parts![/list][/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/4871bcb756460e1239e1d8292e23411de699f803.jpg[/img]
[i]Not sure this chicken should be excited about something called the Chicken Claw Rake.[/i]

[list][*]Creature Builder Updates:
[list][*]Undo/Redo added to Creature Builder (Use the UI buttons, or default hotkeys CTRL-Z & CTRL-Y)
[*]Additional Creature Builder UX improvements[/list]
[*]Tended plants now display a status effect so you can tell if they’ve been fertilized/watered
[*]OSX/Linux builds have returned!
[*]Various bug fixes across all systems (Thank you to everyone reporting bugs! It really helps us out.)[/list]
[h1][b]Thank You![/b][/h1]
We want to send a big thanks to IndieCade, who invited us back as part of their E3 Showcase this year! We had a ton of fun meeting everyone and got some great feedback from people who stopped by to play CHKN. (The Arena on Pre-Release was a big hit!)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/5f838d56a508b51a6b970ce4456d93ab7a862352.jpg[/img]

Please [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/]post on our forums[/url] with your feedback! Or come join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/xaeqGp8]CHKN discord[/url] share your thoughts, finding people to play with, or just to hang out. We’ve even got a whole channel dedicated to sharing creature creations so don’t forget to save yours to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/workshop/]Workshop[/url] so we can admire them.

[i]- Team CHKN[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/420930/CHKN/

notes.title: Creature Design Challenge #3 Winners!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/6231cc3473af8048d683bd6f25f4cfdee528f950.jpg[/img]

First off, thank you to everyone who entered our latest design challenge. You guys really put the newly revamped Life Blocks to the test! To see all the amazing entries, check out [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1405178678]this Workshop Collection[/url] and subscribe to spawn them in your own games from the Bestiary. (Note that you’ll need to be on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/305510202673028167/]Pre-Release[/url] to get all the revamped Life Blocks!) All of the creations were really creative and you may see some of these creatures in the wilds of CHKN soon!

Also, huge thanks to our guest judges, Jacemachine and squidking! They put a lot of effort into judging and discussing entries, thinking about how creatures look and fit into the world, and testing them in the game to see how they move and fight. Thanks, guys!

On to the winners!

[h1][b]Winners[/b][/h1]
Plural! Our guest judges were debating the merits of these two creatures in the end so why not choose both? ;)

[b]The formidable [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1401534417]Crabosapien by DINOBOY[/url].[/b]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1401534417][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/e8eaa2de9a253faec25a2f7acc67216cb76e9f79.jpg[/img][/url]

It’s only made of crab parts and it’s a bit deceptive at first glance, but our guest judges liked the cool humanoid shape and that it’s quite tough in a fight. It’s got great movement in battle and can throw a mean uppercut at you. “Which is also awesomely cool, unless you are the one that’s claw-uppercutted”, says squidking. This will make a great creature for players to run into while exploring the beachy areas of the island.

[b]The majestic [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1403796436]Chicat by deathasholds[/url].[/b]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1403796436][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/92f47013c618e1042e31ad1f80a98565334c6133.jpg[/img][/url]

This build combines just two animals (cat and chicken) very well into a wonderful “gryphon-esque” creature. Jacemachine says “it looks great in action, and it’s just a handsome build overall.” We definitely agree. It’s Teleporting Vanish ability does make it interesting to fight, but really this creature is all about good looks. We’d love to run into this in the wild and tame it for our own. (And build larger, mama Chicats to guard her babies.)

[h1][b]Runners Up[/b][/h1]
We also wanted to get in on the judging action so here are some of our favorite creatures from all the amazing entries.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1403871377]RoboSnakeapede[/url] is also by deathasholds but we couldn’t help calling it out. It’s got quite the wow factor, especially when you see it move around in the world.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1403871377][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/39820890145dab09743c1a1ed73264b36724dad6.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1399619672]Griminilim by Jelly Butter[/url] is just so creepily cute. Look at that face! The eyes really draw you in. (We love the name, too.)

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1399619672][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/e47d5285dfbfc2792b10fba3cd5187e3fa0d358e.jpg[/img][/url]

There’s something about [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1404029153]Duble clucker by Lordofd[/url] that feels very CHKNy. It’s super interesting and weird, and that makes it great.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1404029153][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/0f24825b5c913189b76601d4be3b70a0011d3593.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1402400199]MechaChkn by Dinoman9877[/url] is definitely a mad scientist creation. We don’t want to meet that scientist (or see the creature made up of the other halves).

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1402400199][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/377c1bc8f703364f32ca537150098b79696687ab.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1400027101]Salamander by Tycothepug[/url] is somehow cute despite using some of the creepiest parts. Watch it walk around in game and react to the world. You’ll want one as a pet!

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1400027101][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/ef14b6d596ef4de353ed00531725b3cba7d2a0b3.jpg[/img][/url]

Finally, there’s [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1400242831]Hat Cat[/url], also by Jelly Butter. We have no idea what this is but it’s amazing anyway.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1400242831][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/0ba8510acbfc1cbcde4e8beac799c8081c44730c.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1][b]Congrats & Thanks![/b][/h1]

Congrats to all the winners and honorable mentions, and thanks for all the amazing entries! Don’t forget that you can subscribe to them all using this handy list so you can spawn them in your own games.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1405178678]Design Challenge #3 Submissions Collection[/url]

We also showed off some of these creations on our developer stream early today so check that out to see some of them in action.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4pIL1UHrioc 
And thanks again to the judges! Definitely check out [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCnYjURzRMeWp8dxHnK0W94w]Jacemachine’s YouTube Channel[/url] when you get the chance. His CHKN videos are really fun and he plays other survival and creative games, too! And if you’re looking for really interesting and fun creatures for your games, you’re guaranteed to find something you love in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198336208142/myworkshopfiles/?appid=420930]squidking’s Workshop Creations[/url].

We hope you all had fun creating your entries using the revamped Life Blocks. (More are on the way!)  It’s so much fun looking through all your creations and we’re constantly inspired by your creativity. We can’t wait to see what you build next!

[i]- Team CHKN[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/420930/CHKN/

notes.title: Creature Design Contest #3 (Guest Judges!)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/cd3a0d795a98cf077e7441166e27b20c29b7dd3b.jpg[/img]

Got a pig-snake-dog you want to share with the world? It's time for another Creature Design contest! 

Test out our new revamped creatures on Pre-Release and submit your creations. ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/305510202673028167/]Here’s how to access Pre-Release[/url]!) Guest judges from the community will help us pick the winners and the winning creatures will inspire the new wild ecosystem coming soon in CHKN! (We’re currently working on adding some of the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/420930/announcements/detail/1470852515490533025]past[/url] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/420930/announcements/detail/1672392937602986068]winners[/url] to the new Adventure Mode so look out for those!)

[b]You have until June 5th to enter.[/b] Winners will be revealed during our live stream next Friday (June 8).

[b][i]PRE-RELEASE TROUBLESHOOTING NOTE: If you were having trouble getting the Pre-Release to load, we also have some bug fixes and a solution for you at the bottom of this post![/i][/b]

Now on to the contest...

[h1][b]The Rules[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Play the Pre-Release build and create a creature using Life Blocks from any of the 7 newly revamped creatures:
[list][*]Chicken
[*]Cat
[*]Crab
[*]Mech Dino
[*]Dog
[*]Snake
[*]Pig[/list]
[*]Is it cute or intentionally abominus? Is your creature dangerous or helpful or playful? Use the new Life Blocks in creative combinations to make your creature unique.
[*]We’re looking for anything from small creatures a new player might come across early in Adventure Mode to large boss creatures you might encounter later in the game. Think about where your creature might live in the CHKN world.
[*]Judges will rate your creatures on:
[list][*]Looks
[*]Personality
[*]Movement & Functionality[/list][/list]

[h1][b]Our Guest Judges![/b][/h1]
A couple amazing creators from the CHKN community have agreed to join us as guest judges for this contest!

[b]Squidking[/b] is a creature creating machine, with over [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198336208142/myworkshopfiles/?appid=420930]200 creatures shared in the Workshop[/url]. You should also check out his [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1238132843]CHKN Creature Wiki[/url] if you want to know all about some of the creatures you can find out in the wild.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/41517a2f9863838f70ee682d2ec5fa8232994287.jpg[/img]
[i]Now you know what a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1272466944]Goat riding a cat[/url] looks like.[/i]

[b]Jacemachine[/b] plays a bunch of creative sandbox and survival games on his hilariously entertaining [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCnYjURzRMeWp8dxHnK0W94w]YouTube channel[/url]. He’s built plenty of creative creatures while surviving the wilds of CHKN. Check out his latest video hunting dragons...

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5jDYL_myyas
They’ll be seeing first hand how tough it is to judge the amazing creatures everyone submits to our contests. Thanks, guys!

[h1][b]How to Enter[/b][/h1]
[olist][*]Get on the Pre-Release build using [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/305510202673028167/]these instructions[/url].
[*]Launch CHKN in Creative Mode.
[*]Choose your Life Blocks from the newly revamped creatures and build your creature. Have fun and get creative!
[*]Exit the build sphere and save your creation to the Workshop so we can see it. (Press [TAB] and go to the Bestiary tab of the journal. Find your creature under “My Creations”, click it, and check the “Sync to Steam Workshop” box.)
[*]Make sure to give your creature a name and be sure to [b]add “Creature Challenge #3” to the description[/b] so we can find it.
[*]If you have multiple creature ideas, you can enter as many times as you like! Help us beat our record for the most number of entries![/olist]
That’s it! Make sure to [b]save your creatures to the Workshop before [url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=CHKN+Revamped+Creature+Design+Challenge+Deadline&iso=20180605T2359&p1=179]Tuesday, June 5 @ 23:59:59 EDT[/url][/b] to enter them into the contest! We’ll announce the winners and show off our favorite entries during our next live stream on [url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=CHKN+Dev+Live+Stream&iso=20180608T1530&p1=179]Friday, June 8 @ 3:30 PM EST[/url]. Join us then to see if you’re the lucky winner!

And while you’re testing out the new Life Blocks, make sure to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/]send us your feedback[/url].

[h1][b]Pre-Release Troubleshooting[/b][/h1]
There were two major loading issues we’ve tracked down and fixed with the latest Pre-Release update. If you were having issues, here are the solutions:

[list][*][b]Game window doesn’t appear after pressing Play in Steam[/b]
[list][*]This was a memory issue on our end and we’ve cleared it up. Download the updated build on Pre-Release and it should load properly (within 5 - 10 seconds) the next time you play.[/list]
[*][b]Loading screen stuck at “Loading Terrain”[/b]
[list][*]This is an issue with some .dll files not loading properly because a runtime is missing. We’ve made a fix on our end so that Steam will now properly installs these files when installing the game. If you already have CHKN installed and Steam doesn’t update automatically for you, you can do one of these two things to force it:
[list][*]Option 1: Go to Steam and uninstall CHKN. Then reinstall it. (If you want to make sure to save your games, back them up by copying them first! You can usually find them here: C:\Users\YOUR USERNAME\AppData\LocalLow\Katapult\CHKN)
[*]Option 2: Download the runtime separately and install it on your computer. It’s called “Visual C++ Redistributable for Visual Studio 2015” and you can find it here.[/list]
[*]Once you've done either of these, you should make it through the "Loading Terrain" screen and load into the Main Menu.[/list][/list]

[h1][b]Arena Testing[/b][/h1]
While you’re in the Pre-Release, be sure to check out the Arena. We want your feedback on the new abilities creatures can use in battle. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/]Let us know what you think on the forums[/url].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/0d91ece74b30ec2f359a7ad73a59cc2d56f053db.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Thank you![/b][/h1]
Early Access lets us build CHKN together with all of you so we really appreciate all your support with testing, bug reporting, and sharing your feedback. It helps a ton. Thank you!

Okay, time to get creating. We can’t wait to see your contest creatures!

- Team CHKN

https://store.steampowered.com/app/420930/CHKN/

notes.title: New Features on Pre-Release
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/ef13e2a17d496bd97f3c9e80e600c729edc59901.jpg[/img]

Hi, everyone! It’s been a while! We’ve been in active development on quite a few new things for CHKN and it’s finally time to start getting player feedback! Please help us out by playing our work-in-progress build that’s now up on the Pre-Release branch. [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/305510202673028167/](GET INSTRUCTIONS HERE!)[/url][/b] Thank you!!

There’s some info below on what’s new in this update and we’ll also be doing a livestream [url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=CHKN+Developer+Livestream&iso=20180518T1530&p1=179&ah=1]Friday, May 18 @ 3:30pm EST[/url] to show everything off! Come hang out with us!

[h1][b]New on Pre-Release[/b][/h1]
[list][*][b]Arena Update & Bug Fixes: [/b]New abilities for you to try out in battle. Use the new arena glossary to see which Life Blocks you need to use in your creature to unlock each ability. Here are a few examples. Discover the rest by playing the Pre-Release!
[list][*]Sample “ability” combos:
[list][*]Crab legs + Crab shell blocks = Hunker Down (armored force field)
[*]2 Mech Dino eyes = Laser Eye
[*]Chicken comb = Squawk Stun
[*]Cat legs + Cat tail = Teleport Vanish
[*]50% Cat blocks = Nine Lives (automatic revive)[/list]
[/list][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/45dbe4dd2e397303d55774c6c48a22d18a5b5657.jpg[/img]
[i]Armored Force Field and Laser Beam in action! Try different abilities out against each other. (You can also see the revamped Crab and Mech Dino in this shot!)[/i]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uRHJXjivQq8 [i]Check out streamer [url=https://www.twitch.tv/brettultimus]BrettUltimus[/url] battling some Pokemon replica creatures in the Arena.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/0d91ece74b30ec2f359a7ad73a59cc2d56f053db.jpg[/img]
[i]Use Wing Gust to blow your enemies away… if you can hit them.[/i]
[list][*][b]All New Adventure Mode (In Progress)[/b]
[list][*]A new map, new quest system, and new progression! Inspect wild creatures and collect their abilities to help you and your creatures survive.
[*]This is early in-progress work so there’s missing art, incomplete UI, temporary copy, and other unfinished things, but we’d love to hear what you think so far.[/list][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/f05418bb293cacd1cc0bf6154b5896d9ebc8c5cf.jpg[/img]
[i]Use your new binoculars to inspect wild creatures from afar.[/i]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SBme42G9b_A [i]See some of the abilities in action and how to discover them in Adventure Mode.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/90646fe6a947caf10dd30aa9bc96f155e34df6e2.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b]Creature Builder Overhaul[/b]
[list][*]New Life Block panel and filters, updated UI, some new stats added, plus a new Move Tool that lets you move whole chains of blocks around on your creature. (No more deleting a bunch of work and starting over.) Try it out and let us know what you think![/list][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/74a1a71a3fa210ac1d731e33dad4128bf4ca00bd.jpg[/img]
[i]New Creature Builder! (UI in progress.)[/i]
[list][*][b]Creature Collections[/b]
[list][*]Browse the new creature collection to see all types of creatures found in CHKN.
[list][*]My Creations: Creatures you’ve built
[*]Discovered/Bestiary: Creatures you’ve observed/discovered in Adventure Mode
[*]Workshop: Creatures you’ve subscribed to in Steam Workshop, plus browse all creatures in Steam Workshop to see what’s new and subscribe to more
[*]Favorites: Your favorite creatures from any of the previous lists[/list][/list][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/91a19bd170d9f4b99bc39d1b7edff518180a33ea.jpg[/img]

Things to note about this build:
[list][*]This version is Windows only for now. We’re working on getting the other platforms soon.
[*]Multiplayer isn’t available on Pre-Release at the moment because of the new Adventure Mode. It’ll be back in a future update.[/list]

[h1][b]We Need Your Feedback[/b][/h1]
[b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/]TELL US YOUR FEEDBACK HERE![/url][/b] Our goal is to get these new & updated features out to everyone on the main live branch. We’ll be updating our progress on Pre-Release every couple weeks until it’s ready, so we need all your testing and feedback to help us get there! Please tell us things like:
[list][*]How’s the new Creature Builder?
[list][*]Is it easier to build what you want?
[*]How about moving around parts of your creatures?
[*]Is there anything you’d change to make building better?[/list][/list]
[list][*]Do you like the new creature abilities?
[list][*]What new abilities were your favorite in the Arena?
[*]Were there any you didn’t like and why?
[*]Did you have fun experimenting?[/list][/list]
[list][*]Do you like the new Adventure Mode we have in progress?
[list][*]Are the new quests clear? Even though it’s in progress, did you understand what you were supposed to do?
[*]Did you get through all the quests or did you get stuck anywhere?
[*]Is there anything you’d add or change about it?[/list][/list]
[list][*]Do you put pineapple on pizza or is that an abomination?
[list][*]Okay this one isn’t really on topic but we’re curious anyway.[/list][/list]

You can answer any of the questions above or leave any other feedback you have for us [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/]on the Pre-Release forums[/url]. Thank you!

[h1][b]Patch Notes [v0.6.1][/b][/h1]
For those of you curious about everything that’s been updated in this build, here are the full patch notes.

[b]Creatures[/b]
[list][*]Creature Ability System overhauled
[list][*]Now supports granting abilities based off of Life Block makeup and construction of your creature (type of blocks used, how many, where they’re placed on a creature, etc.)
[*]Browse abilities in the new Abilities Glossary
[*]Assign abilities to a creature’s Ability Bar. The creature AI will use those abilities, or use them yourself by taking direct control of the creature.
[*]Added new abilities to the system! Discover them in Adventure Mode or test them on new creatures in the Arena.
[list][*]Egg Missile
[*]Teleport Vanish
[*]Hunker Down
[*]Laser Eye
[*]Squawk Stun
[*]Tail Strike
[*]Feather Storm
[*]Nine Lives[/list][/list]

[*]Animal art updates! 5 animal types have been completely revamped with new art and blocks.
[list][*]Chicken
[*]Cat
[*]Crab
[*]Mech Dino
[*]Dog
[*]More coming in the next update! (Snake, Pig, Cow, and more)[/list]

[*]Creature Builder overhauled
[list][*]New Move Tool added. Move whole sections of your creature or remove them completely.
[*]New Life Block browser for faster, easier selection; plus filter by animal type
[*]Updated stats section with some new stats added
[*]Updated hotkeys for quick tool swapping (add, move, camera focus, and grid toggle)
[*]Updated highlighting to more easily tell where blocks can be placed, which ones you’re selecting to move/delete, etc.[/list]

[*]New Creature Stat system implemented: new stats added, more stats made visible to players, and all stats tuned for consistency

[*]Creature XP system added so creatures can progress through Adventure Mode

[*]Creature Stress system added
[list][*]New stat bar added to Bonded creatures representing Stress
[*]Stress increases during combat or work
[*]If it reaches 100%, the creature will become Stressed and other stats are penalized
[*]Playing with creatures reduces their Stress so take good care of them![/list]

[*]Animation System Improvements
[list][*]Support for front and back legs
[*]Support for arms
[*]Improved performance
[*]Better quality tracking
[*]Improved consistency for striking
[*]Basic creature swimming added[/list][/list]
[b]Features[/b]
[list][*]Adventure Mode is back!
[list][*]Try out an early version of the new Adventure Mode in progress!
[*]All new on-boarding to teach the ins and outs of CHKN.
[*]New storyline: After being shipwrecked, you’ll need to craft items and build creatures to help you survive, then explore the island to discover wild creatures and learn their abilities for your own creatures, all while trying to save the world. No biggie.
[*]New progression and balancing: new wild creatures, tweaks to stats and combat, crafting recipes changed, new XP and Lifeshaper upgrade system in progress, etc.
[*]Note: Copy and quest steps aren’t final and much of the art is “greybox”
[/list]

[*]Binoculars & Bestiary Added
[list][*]Use the binoculars to observe wild creatures from afar to learn their stats, info, and abilities and log them in your Bestiary.
[*]Once observed, those creature’s abilities are then unlocked for use in your own creatures.[/list]

[*]New Notification System added
[list][*]Get notifications and some quick info about new items you pick up or things you discover in the world.
[*]Get updates about completed or new objectives[/list]

[*]New Quest System Added
[list][*]Track your objectives in Adventure Mode. On-boarding quests give way to story quests as you progress through the Adventure.[/list]

[*]New Journal added
[list][*]Inventory menu expanded to a full Journal, with multiple tabs for new and existing functionality. Find everything you need in CHKN in this Journal. 
[*]Current status of each tab: 
[list][*]Character: Shows your armor, stats, and inventory (Currently using the old system while we finish this tab)
[*]Crafting: Will house the new crafting menu. (Currently blank while we complete this system. Go to Character to craft for now!)
[*]Bonded Creatures: Overhauled to provide more information about your bonded creatures.
[*]Objectives: Keep track of things to do in the world. Only available in Adventure Mode. (a.k.a. quests!)
[*]Bestiary/Creature Collection: Shows only your Bestiary in Adventure Mode. Otherwise, see the full Creature Collection including all creatures you’ve created, your favorites, your Workshop subscriptions, and browse the full Workshop.
[*]Map: Find important things in the world. (Currently not finished. Use the binoculars (E) to set waypoints.)
[*]Help: A list of topics if you need help while playing CHKN.[/list][/list]

[*]Dialogue System added: The game can display messages to you as part of the story.[/list]
[b]Items & Crafting[/b]
[list][*]Cooking Cleaver Added
[list][*]Striking life blocks generates raw meat
[*]Striking fruit generates seeds[/list]
[*]Crafting recipes changed for new Adventure Mode progression (new crafting menu and workbenches coming soon)[/list]
[b]Fancy Art[/b]
[list][*]New environment art! New trees, updated bushes with new fruits, better grass, more foliage added to environments, etc.
[*]VFX added for new abilities
[*]Trail effects added on existing strike abilities
[*]Fur Shaders added to dog and cat
[*]Post Processing adjusted to be visually pleasing[/list]
[b]Bugs & Optimization[/b]
[list][*]Added Texture Streaming for improved memory performance and improved visuals
[*]Added auto quality detection to optimize the settings based off of PC specs
[*]Various changes throughout the UI
[*]Foliage rendering system changed to remove floating bugs and improved visuals
[*]Rough support for Map added[/list]
[h1][b]Creature Contest Coming Soon[/b][/h1]
We’d love to see what you guys can do with the revamped creature Life Blocks so we’ll be holding another Creature Creation Contest in the Workshop! Keep a look out for an announcement with the build rules and theme early next week.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/fa31274f45022c4d8fa4cd07f44ddc430269ad07.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Livestream Today![/b][/h1]
We’ll be back on [url=http://www.twitch.tv/chkngame]Twitch[/url] and [url=http://gaming.youtube.com/chknchannel/live]YouTube[/url] this afternoon—[url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=CHKN+Developer+Livestream&iso=20180518T1530&p1=179&ah=1]Friday, May 18 @ 3:30pm EST[/url]—to show you all this new stuff in progress and answer any questions. Come hang out with us!

If you can’t make the stream, don’t forget you can also [url=http://www.chkngame.com/getnewsletter]sign up for our Newsletter[/url] to keep up on the latest CHKN news.

We hope you like the new build! We’ve got more to do so it’s back to work for us. See you on the stream!

[i]- Team CHKN[/i]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/420930/CHKN/

notes.title: Pre-Release Patch: Arena Mode - CHKN Brawl
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/0fb612b0a977b0d2843b85b269ee04df591defa4.jpg[/img]

The all-new [b]Arena Mode[/b] (CHKN Brawl) and [b]Creature Collection[/b] feature are now on Pre-Release (instructions below). We need your feedback! Test creatures in a new ‘creature brawl’ and tell us your suggestions on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/]the forums[/url] or over on our [url=https://discord.gg/xaeqGp8]Discord server[/url]. We want to know what you think.

[h1][b]v0.6.0 Pre-Release Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[b]New Features[/b]
[list][*]New mode: Arena!
[list][*]It’s time for a good ol’ fashioned creature brawl. Pick two teams to enter the arena and battle it out in a best-of series format. The last team standing wins.
[*]Choose creatures from your own creations or find contenders on Steam Workshop.
[*]Spectate the battle or control creatures directly during the fight.
[*]Check out our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LOIGkj0Wb9M]developer stream video[/url] where we test out the Arena.
[*]Note: Multiplayer and more creature abilities coming soon![/list][/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JzP88JN.gif[/img]

[*]Creature Collection Added
[list][*]Browse, search, add, remove, duplicate, and subscribe to creatures all in one place. 
[*]Filter creatures by different stats or search using the text field.
[*]Wild creatures you discover while exploring in Adventure Mode are also added to the Collection under “Discovered”. [i](NOTE: Currently, all wild creatures are revealed to all profiles while we upgrade Adventure Mode.)[/i]
[*]Use the Collection to spawn creatures in Creative Mode or choose challengers in Arena Mode.[/list][/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/e553e4f5fb2b12ec5641503b623a8c0d3f64b7af.jpg[/img]

[list][*]New Profile-Based Save System
[list][*]Save your progress, game worlds, and creatures to separate player profiles.
[list][*]Creative Mode games are now saved per profile.
[*]Adventure Mode games/progress are now linked to a profile. [i](NOTE: Adventure Mode is currently not available on pre-release.)[/i][/list]
[*]Note: In future, the profile system will track discovered wild creatures per profile and let you bring your profile’s bonded creatures and items with you into multiplayer games.[/list]
[*]Test drive of Procedurally Generated Terrain System
[list][*]We are testing a new system to randomly generate terrains and more easily create new maps and areas for you to explore in various game modes.
[*]Note: You’ll see new environments that are a work in progress.[/list][/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list][*]Side stepping animations have been added to chicken legs
[*]Gameplay is now paused when loading so you won’t miss any action when playing single player
[*]New foliage system added for improved graphics and better performance
[*]Reduced fog. Go forth and SEE!
[*]Settings are now saved per branch so you can have different settings on Live and Pre-Release.[/list]

[h1][b]Quick Links[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Want to check out the Arena?  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/305510202673028167/]Here’s how to get on Pre-Release.[/url] Your feedback and suggestions help us a lot. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/]Tell us on the forums.[/url]
[*]Looking for a friend for multiplayer? Try [url=https://discord.gg/xaeqGp8]our Discord server[/url]. (Thanks, SquidKing!)
[*]Watch on [url=https://www.youtube.com/chknchannel]YouTube[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/chkngame]Twitch[/url]
[*]Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/chkngame]Twitter[/url]
[*]Sign up for our [url=http://www.chkngame.com/getnewsletter]Newsletter[/url][/list]
Back to work for us! Have a great weekend, everyone.

[i]- Team CHKN[/i]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/420930/CHKN/

notes.title: Creature Design Challenge #2 Winners!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/172a319e706ac1bf1828c57810d30baba892917d.jpg[/img]

Creature Design Challenge #2 is complete and there were so many amazing wild creatures submitted. Thank you to everyone who entered. Seeing what you all create is really fun and gives us lots of ideas for how we can add and improve features in the future!

Here are our picks for the winners! If you want to judge for yourself, check out [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/420930/announcements/detail/3270044456080337318]the rules[/url] and then let us know your votes in the comments below. You can view all the entries in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1272513992]this Workshop Collection[/url] and subscribe to bring them into your own worlds. 

[h1][b]Winner[/b][/h1]
*drumroll* And the winner is [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1267536068]Fluff Fee by Rowdyruff Muffin[/url]!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1267536068][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/950f926bf30e1c888ddc1b9652b73dd2bf30b7c4.jpg[/img][/url]

We love this creature for its unique combination and impressive silhouette. It moves really well in the world and it’s got a lot of personality in the face and “eyebrows”. Also, bonus points for chest hair. This would be an imposing creature pack to run into on an adventure in the wild.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TG9DpZg.gif[/img]

Fluff Fee uses new chicken blocks that are only available on our in-progress version of the game, so be sure to [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/305510202673028167/]install the Pre-Release build[/url] to see this creature in its full glory!

Congrats, Rowdyruff Muffin! Look for Fluff Fee out in the wild in a future CHKN release.

[h1][b]Runners Up[/b][/h1]
These two creatures had great potential to introduce ideas for players and are just plain interesting. Congrats to squidking and Bulborb87!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1269911440]Beefy Invader by squidking[/url] uses limited parts to create a creature that takes advantage of the voxelization and chain animation systems, making sure it stays upright when it charges at you with its “spears”.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1269911440][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/09479501a4c8c4c0db8818716a1fee176e7443f8.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1268042170]Spider Cat Cow by Bulborb87[/url] is what we’d call “creepycute” and would hide well in the tall grass. You may see its head and think it’s harmless, only to turn and flee the minute you see it and all its pals scurrying right at you on their surprise spider legs.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1268042170][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/65710fc8f7901c67fe4e5bc6bde560f9e4b0f00e.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1][b]Honorable Mentions[/b][/h1]
And here are some great creatures we loved for a variety of different reasons!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1218048700]Sir Dollinger by Rowdyruff Muffin[/url] is all personality packed into a few blocks and everyone laughed hysterically when we loaded it up. We immediately started making up stories for how it’d fit into wild. (Like you should find an abandoned hut in the middle of nowhere and THIS is inside and who knows what happens next…) Try it out in your own worlds!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1218048700][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/7b4851b7579decbc6e1348237ee5056bf38ce375.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1270813761]Light LLama by The Stray[/url] is a nocturnal creature you might run into while exploring the darkness. Plus the placement of the lures on the head and the short, slower legs makes it really fun to watch as it roams around or flees from danger.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1270813761][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/12efe7f2050bd4fe968df9436e2194dd6e32cd99.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1268810379]Little Cat by lisrinerrase[/url] is just so darn cute. It’s small but would be fun to stumble upon in a pack and figure out how you might want to deal with them. And its walk cycle is great. Load up a bunch of them and just watch them roam around. It’s mesmerizing.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1268810379][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/38d39c88481c09d213c4de7ad6be2071ba571ab3.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1268856856]Hairhog by squidking[/url] is one of those creatures that scares you when you first come across it, looking so intimidating from afar, but then you investigate and realise it’s adorable. We still wouldn’t underestimate it, though.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1268856856][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/a304cf01dd897237c67020bc83eb8fcc623a6de6.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1268660774]Blantosaur by Ultimate Oddball[/url] is strange in the best way. Running across one of these would be quite perplexing. We also love how the “nose” was built and moves in the game. It’s a really creative combo of three animal types.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1268660774][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/2b9c85e561f126527d6931a303237a6ed98896f8.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1266902869]Turtle Trunk by GreenRock[/url] technically used three animal types… but only if trees don’t count as animals. Which we guess they don’t, but we never mentioned that in the rules whoops! Totally our fault! In any case, this shows off how other blocks can be used to build fun, interesting creatures.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1266902869][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/c35097e9658b44d691e86da6955a783e2841e08d.jpg[/img][/url]

And [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1270967410]Fresser by X=X..X=X[/url] used WAY too many animal types for the challenge, but still managed to fit in a lot of ability blocks that all function really well while still looking super cool into one creature. So we wanted to give it a shoutout here. Awesome work.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1270967410][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/9e598caf7ff8f374bad72a7683e887a35554715c.jpg[/img][/url]
 
We showed off some of these creations and explained more of what we liked about them on our last developer stream so check that out to see some of them in action.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3j3JdndHfm0&t=14m38s
And as previously mentioned, you can subscribe to all of the amazing entries from this handy list so you can load them up in your worlds:

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1272513992][b]Design Challenge #2 Submissions Collection[/b][/url]

If you want to share your own creatures with us and your fellow CHKN players in the Workshop, just hold [E] while facing your finished creature and select “Save to Workshop". We’re always on the lookout for cool creations to add to the game! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Bjeyh30.gif[/img]

We hope you all had fun creating your entries for this challenge. We had blast looking through them all we’re constantly inspired by your creations. We can’t wait to see what you build next!

[i]- Team CHKN[/i]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/420930/CHKN/

notes.title: Creature Design Contest #2
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/22aeb49a928889b460d162eb96322684a8d4a75f.jpg[/img]
[i]A wild Dubsheep under construction...[/i]

We want you to design the first set of new wild creatures for the world of CHKN. Submit your creature combos and we’ll choose which of your creations will roam wild in our next release!

Your challenge this time around is to create fun and interesting wild creatures made only using Life Blocks from up to 3 animal types. Players discover wild creatures while exploring so they can be friendly island inhabitants or aggressive foes.

We had so much fun on the last challenge seeing your boss designs that we’d never have come up with ourselves. We also learned a lot from how you built your creatures. We can’t wait to see what you all come up with this round!

[h1][b]The Rules[/b][/h1]
[olist][*]Create a small or medium-sized wild creature you’d expect to run into while exploring early on in Adventure Mode.
[list][*]Is it dangerous or cute? Stand-alone or roams in packs? It’s up to you![/list]
[*]Build your wild creature using only the Life Blocks from [i][b]up to three animal types[/b][/i].
[list][*]So, maybe a cat-dog? Or a plant-dino-sheep? Or how about a spider-cow? You can choose any three (or fewer) animals you like, then use any parts from those three animals in your creature.[/list]
[*]We’ll be judging your creatures on:
[list][*]Functionality
[*]Personality
[*]Looks[/list][/olist]
[h1][b]How to Enter[/b][/h1]
[olist][*]Launch CHKN in Creative Mode.
[*]Choose your animal types and build your creature using their Life Blocks. Have fun and get creative!
[*]Exit the build sphere and save your creation to the Workshop so we can see it. (Use the [Q] command on your creature and select “Save to Workshop”.)
[*]Make sure to give your creature a name and be sure to [i][b]add “Creature Challenge #2” to the title or description[/b][/i] so we can find it.[/olist]
That’s it! If you have multiple ideas, you can enter as many times as you like.

[i][b]Save your creatures to the Workshop before [url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=CHKN+Wild+Creature+Design+Challenge+Deadline&iso=20180116T2359&p1=179]Tuesday, January 16 @ 23:59:59 EST[/url] to enter them into the contest![/b][/i]

We’ll announce the winners and show off our favorite entries during our next live stream on [url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=CHKN+Dev+Live+Stream&iso=20180119T1530&p1=179]Friday, January 19 @ 3:30 PM EST[/url]. Join us then to see if you’re the lucky winner.

[h1][b]Get Inspired in the Workshop[/b][/h1]
If you want to check out what other people have made and get ideas for your own creatures, be sure to browse [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/workshop/]the Workshop[/url]! You can rate your favorites and subscribe to download them to your own worlds.

While you’re at it, check out this awesome [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1238132843]CHKN Creature Wiki by squidking[/url]. There’s a rundown of some of the creatures you find while exploring the island, including screenshots, stats, and strategies.

[h1][b]New adventures for 2018...[/b][/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/6c39bbc956f6ca2b77a3a11965e3c7be1974ba46.jpg[/img]

We’ve got lots planned in 2018! First up is an “arena” mode that will roll out on Pre-Release next month. If you want to follow along with our progress, you can:
[list][*]Download our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/305510202673028167/]Pre-Release build[/url] so you’ll get the updates as soon as they’re available.
[*][url=http://www.chkngame.com/getnewsletter]Sign up for our newsletter[/url] to keep up to date with the latest news.
[*]Subscribe to our YouTube channel, where we post our developer videos and playlists featuring creator videos. (Check out our [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLl-hadC10UzcdfnSo1GRSPAFiMQp0TlMA]Best of 2017 Playlist[/url]!)[/list]
Thanks for all your support, everyone! We’re in Early Access because we want to build CHKN together with all of you and you’ve been amazing. We look forward to all your feedback, ideas, videos, and creations in 2018!

[i]- Team CHKN[/i]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/420930/CHKN/

notes.title: Workshop Spotlight & Pre-Release Progress
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/1803f91c1893e5d6f5da0e752f49878dc734dda4.jpg[/img]

First off, thank you so much for all your support and feedback this year. (And all your crazy creatures!) You guys motivate us to keep making CHKN great and we really appreciate it. Happy holidays from the CHKN Team!

We’re doing one last dev stream in 2017 so come join us! We’ll be live on [url=http://www.twitch.tv/chkngame]Twitch[/url] and [url=http://gaming.youtube.com/chknchannel/live]YouTube[/url] tomorrow (Fri, Dec 22) at [url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=CHKN+Dev+Live+Stream&iso=20171222T1530&p1=179]3:30 pm EST[/url] pitting our own creatures against some of your creations from the Workshop. Help us choose combatants or just hang out and chat with us!

Now, let’s fill our last post of the year with some awesome creatures and a few sneak peeks, shall we?

[h1][b]Community Creature Spotlight[/b][/h1]
If you’re looking for cute, creative, or crazy new creatures to check out, here are a few of our recent favorites from [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/workshop/]the Workshop[/url]. Try them out in your own games! (Click the “Subscribe” button on a creature’s page and then press 'U' in Creative Mode to find them in your Subscribed tab.)

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1195757170][img]https://i.imgur.com/uoXLfoI.gif[/img][/url]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1195757170]R A C E C A R by Ghost[/url] is super fun to drive around. And it breathes fire so that’s a plus. Get a group together and race against your friends!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1227888290][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/eb7df5688d6cb23d4053a6202a474cf61f4d23a3.jpg[/img][/url]
Is it weird that [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1227888290]Hotdog by squidking[/url] looks delicious? Follow-up question: Is it lunch time yet?

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1217846248][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/8ed0a87b5f75fb0505aed9223164ad985098cf2c.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1217846248]Bunny Cheerleader by Rowdyruff Muffin[/url] will be there to cheer you and your creatures on during those tough times. YOU CAN DO IT!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1232683215][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/4e54fa9322a7949872aff00ef431357fda95abcb.jpg[/img][/url]
We really like this creative use of blocks in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1232683215]ARCTIC ICE FLOW by susan the water dragon[/url]. Look at the penguin!!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=970607352][img]https://i.imgur.com/3upZvj6.gif[/img][/url]
If you haven’t seen it yet, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=970607352]CHKN Logo 3.0 by Tycothepug[/url] is an amazing update on the original. Load it up in a game to see it in all its glory.

Got some favorites you think we should add to our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=864755386]CHKN Team Favorites collection[/url]? Or maybe you have a theme idea for our next creature creation contest (coming soon!)? Let us know in the comments below!

[h1][b]Pre-Release Work in Progress[/b][/h1]
We’ve got quite a few things in the works but here’s a sneak peek of some of the graphical updates coming soon to Pre-Release.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/260579a9441ea2c4ab5da46aa6e854846880e663.jpg[/img]
Tall, obtrusive grass has been a common issue reported in the past so we’re updating it! This is GPU powered grass. No longer in your face but also much more lush. It also bends when touched and animates with the wind.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/ff8ba2b105c89fbb5fb5caa46f7b006d51d98081.jpg[/img]
We’re using a new terrain shader to realistically blend textures with heightmaps and create added detail, like on the edges of this dirt path cutting through the new grass.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/ac2e1054da52ea2c86605e0707d7f5e34bd04158.jpg[/img]
Another color correction pass is making the creatures and environment more vibrant and really bringing them to life.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/3dcc75fcf53b5da64d55a015606fb650ffd0d071.jpg[/img]
The skybox also got a fix so it’s nice and blue when the weather is clear! (And not so nice during those pesky storms.) The cows are really happy about it.

If you want to help us test these kinds of changes, check out the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/305510202673028167/]Pre-Release FAQ & Instructions[/url]. And don’t forget to [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/]post your feedback[/url] so we know what you think!

[h1][b]Farewell, 2017![/b][/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UzSBol6.gif[/img]
[i]Gliding into 2018 like a boss.[/i]

Happy holidays! We hope the rest of your 2017 is great and we’ll see you in the new year. We’ve got a lot of exciting stuff coming in 2018 and we can’t wait to share it with you! (Make sure to [url=http://www.chkngame.com/getnewsletter]sign up for our newsletter[/url] so you don’t miss anything!)

[i]- Team CHKN[/i]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/420930/CHKN/
