notes.title: Boss Design Challenge Winners!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/393f26aafdfb85e15a4529f3434c2011a1b4d030.png[/img]

Huge thanks to everyone who entered our inaugural Creature Design Challenge: Bosses! We had a tough time choosing but ‘tis the life of a CHKN scientist. If you didn’t win this time, don’t worry. We want to fill CHKN with all your awesome creations so we’ll have another design challenge for you soon.

These are our choices. We also want to hear your votes in the comments below so we can put your favorites in a future release! Let us know which creatures you’d love to fight against (or even just run across) in CHKN.

[h1][b]Winner[/b][/h1]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1214099198][b]Runihara Thanatos by Ultimate Oddball![/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/f3a683d5568000240b22a04aae69c4666d9695ca.png[/img][/url]

Runihara is definitely a creature we don’t want to run into while exploring, which is why it makes an excellent boss creation. Looks and functions great in-game? Check. Quick and scrappy? Check. High health and DPS? Check. Multiple abilities? Check. Tough and fun to face off against in a fight? Double Check!

Congrats, Ultimate Oddball! We’ll be adding Runihara Thanatos to the game in a future release.

[h1][b]Runners Up[/b][/h1]
These creatures were also really fun to fight and look great in-game. Plus they kind of give us nightmares. Congrats to ramenhar and Jelly Butter!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1215041387]Cow spider by ramenhar[/url] will come at you quickly and then there’s fire everywhere. Fun to fight against, and frightening but also kinda cute somehow!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1215041387][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/b218b8b15c9ffa38d25e00b1c729d2d08dbdc954.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1212037605]Arms by Jelly Butter[/url] has an amazing strike attack that’s very effective. It may seem like a hug at first but don’t be fooled. Pro Tip: dodge and weave!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1212037605][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/b0d42a216312f7ce4d42179e389ae84318eb523a.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1][b]Honorable Mentions[/b][/h1]
These are some great submissions that we loved for their own awesome reasons.

Weirdest entry goes to [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1209377278]Hugh-Man by Rowdyruff Muffin[/url]. We mean that in a good way, as you can see in this screenshot from its Workshop page. (Rowdyruff’s other entry, Bubblebert, is also weird-in-a-good-way. Check that one out, too.)

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1209377278][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/62656467fafb9686398dc711cdaf0b6c4f500add.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1215228772]Crawly abomination by squidking[/url] was definitely the creepiest. Load this up in your game and then run away screaming. Or tame it if you’re not afraid of spiders... but who’s not afraid of spiders!? (Squidking also has three other great entries so be sure to take a look at those!)

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1215228772][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/1a29583226a69bcd1a7accbd9720ffe245f99444.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1208777191]Scorpion Mech by BarinAsh[/url] isn’t very effective in a fight but it just looks super dang cool. Very creative use of these blocks. (BarinAsh has a whole collection of amazing mech replicants if you like robot creatures.)

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1208777191][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/47e5d7e9ca313eae9182fce55b7802612792aa42.jpg[/img][/url]

We underestimated [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1214147845]Fuzzy Hairder by Lordofd[/url]. We thought fighting this thing would be easy. We were wrong. And it has a great ‘do.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1214147845][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/5539a3b157a2e6a75e789b392945993ce51b0f7e.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1208882558]Cerberus by Crystalseeker[/url] is actually really deadly but... dawwww look. It’s so cute! Tame this and you’ve got an excellent battle companion.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1208882558][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/e6a5cc53182c153baa4587f4d8e1cf89fc63f11f.jpg[/img][/url]

Put a saddle on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1208986055]The Block by Tycothepug[/url] and you have a really great battle mount. Try it out! The attacks are very effective. (And try out Tyco’s other creative entries while you’re at it.)

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1208986055][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/dda7f4d1f95ffa1967da07bed553b89c5b2de97b.jpg[/img][/url]

We did not expect a [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1209945244]Nail Clipper by STEVEBILLYBOB[/url]. It somehow matches its name perfectly, plus it’s fun watching it try to attack with both mouths. (We’ll work on that back neck functionality!)

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1209945244][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/77fb5b74d28a8e59616efd22c73ef8a5b0cfed04.jpg[/img][/url]

And finally, in the “Pfft, Rules Schmules!” category, SpyCakes, ardutton, and JuliaAiko went over the orb limit but we had to show off their creatures anyway.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1208448081]The Land Kraken by SpyCakes[/url] was [i]just[/i] over the orb limit but it’s a beast with both poison and ink shooting. Watching it glide around with its carefully placed octolegs is mesmerizing.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1208448081][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/84fed1e3311050071a7b8bfa901c53a231f4806e.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1211177366]Potoooooooo by ardutton[/url] is a merciless charger, who also looks great with all those feathers. Probably keeps it nice and warm in the winter, too.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1211177366][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/6c6c5d4001b57b1f721929dcea7653305b44d227.jpg[/img][/url]

And this is [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1209989527]Boss Creature by JuliaAiko[/url], the fluffiest T-Rex. Not sure whether to run away or hug it. Many points for creativity.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1209989527][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/e77454fccb1cba3cc312ec8616f545cb60e4e86e.jpg[/img][/url]

(Looks like we need to work on screenshots for larger creatures too, whoops.)

[h1][b]Winner Announcement Live Stream[/b][/h1]
We showed off the winner and runners up in our live stream earlier today and explained more about our choices. Check out the video on YouTube to see them in action!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6PAc2HWaS4c&t=58s
If you want to try out these creations in your own worlds, make sure to subscribe to them in the Workshop. You can use the links above or here’s a handy collection of ALL the submissions for you to play with:

[b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1215825367]Nov '17 Boss Challenge Submissions Collection[/url][/b]

There were some other really great entries that went over the 2400 orb limit rule or weren’t boss fight material even though they looked really cool, etc. We included those in the list anyway. We’re definitely saving some of these to add to the world in the future!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1215825367][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/fe497c4dec97dbeccdf07cf8c0e40fd9b65f65f3.jpg[/img][/url]

Don’t forget that you can always share your amazing creations to the Workshop by using the menu in game. Just hold [E] and select “Save to Workshop".

[img]https://imgur.com/Bjeyh30.gif[/img]

It was a lot of fun looking through all your great entries. We hope you had fun creating them! We can’t wait to see what you build for the next challenge.

[i]- Team CHKN[/i]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/420930/CHKN/

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1208777191][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/47e5d7e9ca313eae9182fce55b7802612792aa42.jpg[/img][/url]

We underestimated [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1214147845]Fuzzy Hairder by Lordofd[/url]. We thought fighting this thing would be easy. We were wrong. And it has a great ‘do.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1214147845][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/5539a3b157a2e6a75e789b392945993ce51b0f7e.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1208882558]Cerberus by Crystalseeker[/url] is actually really deadly but... dawwww look. It’s so cute! Tame this and you’ve got an excellent battle companion.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1208882558][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/e6a5cc53182c153baa4587f4d8e1cf89fc63f11f.jpg[/img][/url]

Put a saddle on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1208986055]The Block by Tycothepug[/url] and you have a really great battle mount. Try it out! The attacks are very effective. (And try out Tyco’s other creative entries while you’re at it.)

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1208986055][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/dda7f4d1f95ffa1967da07bed553b89c5b2de97b.jpg[/img][/url]

We did not expect a [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1209945244]Nail Clipper by STEVEBILLYBOB[/url]. It somehow matches its name perfectly, plus it’s fun watching it try to attack with both mouths. (We’ll work on that back neck functionality!)

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1209945244][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/77fb5b74d28a8e59616efd22c73ef8a5b0cfed04.jpg[/img][/url]

And finally, in the “Pfft, Rules Schmules!” category, SpyCakes, ardutton, and JuliaAiko went over the orb limit but we had to show off their creatures anyway.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1208448081]The Land Kraken by SpyCakes[/url] was [i]just[/i] over the orb limit but it’s a beast with both poison and ink shooting. Watching it glide around with its carefully placed octolegs is mesmerizing.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1208448081][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/84fed1e3311050071a7b8bfa901c53a231f4806e.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1211177366]Potoooooooo by ardutton[/url] is a merciless charger, who also looks great with all those feathers. Probably keeps it nice and warm in the winter, too.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1211177366][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/6c6c5d4001b57b1f721929dcea7653305b44d227.jpg[/img][/url]

And this is [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1209989527]Boss Creature by JuliaAiko[/url], the fluffiest T-Rex. Not sure whether to run away or hug it. Many points for creativity.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1209989527][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/e77454fccb1cba3cc312ec8616f545cb60e4e86e.jpg[/img][/url]

(Looks like we need to work on screenshots for larger creatures too, whoops.)

[h1][b]Winner Announcement Live Stream[/b][/h1]
We showed off the winner and runners up in our live stream earlier today and explained more about our choices. Check out the video on YouTube to see them in action!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6PAc2HWaS4c&t=58s
If you want to try out these creations in your own worlds, make sure to subscribe to them in the Workshop. You can use the links above or here’s a handy collection of ALL the submissions for you to play with:

[b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1215825367]Nov '17 Boss Challenge Submissions Collection[/url][/b]

There were some other really great entries that went over the 2400 orb limit rule or weren’t boss fight material even though they looked really cool, etc. We included those in the list anyway. We’re definitely saving some of these to add to the world in the future!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1215825367][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/fe497c4dec97dbeccdf07cf8c0e40fd9b65f65f3.jpg[/img][/url]

Don’t forget that you can always share your amazing creations to the Workshop by using the menu in game. Just hold [E] and select “Save to Workshop".

[img]https://imgur.com/Bjeyh30.gif[/img]

It was a lot of fun looking through all your great entries. We hope you had fun creating them! We can’t wait to see what you build for the next challenge.

[i]- Team CHKN[/i]

notes.title: Design a Boss for CHKN!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/4d0c731a3680cb4bf0afa25330a123f84575b8af.jpg[/img]

Enter our boss design challenge! [b]Your boss creature could be featured in a future game release[/b], standing guard over some epic loot and striking fear into the hearts of players everywhere. Here’s how to enter. Good luck!

[h1][b]The Rules[/b][/h1]
[olist][*]Build a boss creature within a maximum orb limit of 2400 and save it to the Workshop
[*]That’s it! Your boss creature can use any Life Blocks in any combination you like. It can be scary or cute or a true abomination. It’s up to you.[/olist]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BTZEi9g.jpg[/img]
[i]Whoops! Over 2400 orb limit! Gotta remove some parts...[/i]

[h1][b]How to Enter Your Creation[/b][/h1]
[olist][*]Launch CHKN in Creative Mode
[*]Build your boss under 2400. Have fun and get creative!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/7ef990db3447f71f730f717238096d8c4782599c.png[/img]

[*]Exit the build sphere and save your creation to the Workshop so we can see it. (Use the [Q] command on your creature and select “Save to Workshop”.)

[img]https://imgur.com/Bjeyh30.gif[/img]

[*]Make sure to give your creature a name! Add “Boss Challenge” to the title or description to help us find it more easily.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/4017d581a7d01db9fdaaf2775f6df980e30f3c9b.png[/img]
[/olist]
You’re done! If you have more than one idea, fear not. You can enter as many times as you like.

[h1][b]All creatures saved to the Workshop before [url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=CHKN+Boss+Design+Challenge+Deadline&iso=20171128T2359&p1=179]Tuesday, Nov 28 @ 23:59:59 EST[/url] will be entered into the challenge![/b][/h1]

[h1][b]Who Will Win?[/b][/h1]
Once entries are closed, our crack team of CHKN scientists will go over all the entries and try our best to narrow them down to a winner. We have a feeling this will be really tough but also very fun!

We’ll announce the winners and show off our favorite entries during our next live stream on [url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=CHKN+Dev+Live+Stream&iso=20171201T1530&p1=179]Friday, Dec 1 @ 3:30 PM EST[/url]. Join us!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/ce91703d4e6ac51c0a74b80c00017ec01ed97e60.png[/img]
[i][url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=970607352]CHKN Logo by Tycothepug[/url][/i]

We’ve always wanted to fill the world of CHKN with awesome creatures created by you guys so we figured we’d start big. We can’t wait to see your epic boss creations!

[i]- Team CHKN[/i]

notes.title: Help Test Pre-Release Work in Progress
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/6d3885a51bffbc3c9fa0f1867e88b4614d2ceb2e.jpg[/img]

We’re in progress on development for the future of CHKN.  We want you to test and give us feedback on the pre-release build. Full notes on what’s new and how to install it are below!

Since it’s a work in progress, expect bugs, performance issues, unfinished gameplay, and other weirdness. You can report anything you find [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/]here on the forums[/url]. It really helps and we love hearing from you!

[h1][b]Download Pre-Release[/b][/h1]
To try out all the new features, you’ll need to switch to the Pre-Release (testing) version of CHKN. Just follow these steps:
[olist][*]Right click on CHKN in your Steam Library and select “Properties”.
[*]Click on the “Betas” tab.
[*]In the dropdown menu, select “prerelease”.[/olist]
That’s it! Steam will download the Pre-Release build and you can create a new game to start testing all the new content. (If you ever want to switch back to the stable release build, just select “NONE” from the dropdown at any time. Your saved games will still be there when you return!)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/0687e5d7a6c8faacc856ca50ada15ffe16396e4c.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Testing Tip: Teleporting![/b][/h1]
To help you move around more quickly while testing, you can also teleport. Hit [Enter] and type one of these /teleport commands into the chat bar. Then hold onto your shorts!
[list][*]New zone starting area: /teleport 3477 83 3366
[*]Old starting temple: /teleport -2593 69 439
[*]Forest temple: /teleport -1356 107 -137
[*]Desert temple: /teleport 82 129 402
[*]Swamp temple: /teleport -48 155 -1085[/list]
[h1][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h1]
[b]New Features[/b]
[list][*]New Adventure Mode Starting Area: a whole new starting experience to explore!
[list][*]Includes a new biome (Tropical Oasis/Beach) with improved art style for all new assets: vegetation, trees, terrain, textures, and items (food & resources)
[*]New wild chicken, pig, dog, and cow creature variations (leave your favorites in the comments!)
[*]First pass at updated tutorial mechanics and new prompts to teach new players in a clearer way
[list][*]Tutorial messages will now pause the game and display important information the first time a player encounters an item or a game mechanic[/list]
[*]Solve new puzzles, find hidden treasure chests, and defeat a brand new boss CHKN at the end of the zone
[*]Completing the tutorial takes you to the old tutorial’s “starter temple” to continue your adventures in the larger world (which will be updated to the new art style in the future!)[/list]
[*]Updated life blocks and textures
[list][*]Revamped chicken: updated life blocks (eye, mouth, wing, leg, comb) + new body block variations and textures
[list][*]Smaller blocks are lighter, larger ones are tougher… experiment with Life Block combinations![/list]
[*]Updated dog textures
[*]More creatures will be revamped in the coming months as we continue to add more meaning and depth to creature building.[/list]
[*]New creature ability: Glide
[list][*]Chicken wings now unlock the Glide ability!
[list][*]We’ll be adding more abilities/AI/animations unlocked by specific Life Blocks in the coming months. Suggestions welcome![/list]
[*]Ride a creature (using a saddle), then hold spacebar to jump and glide through the air.
[*]Best to pick up momentum before hand by sprinting.
[*]Consumes stamina per wing attached (if a creature is out of stamina mid-glide, it will fall to the ground)
[*]Gliding fall rate is determined by the mass mass of creature vs the amount of attached wings.
[list][*]Tip: Try making your your chicken lighter and/or faster to glide farther in a single jump.[/list][/list][/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list][*]Stamina bar added to the UI
[list][*]Added for both the player (you!) and tamed/bonded creatures
[*]Stamina will decrease when sprinting, running, rolling, performing melee strikes, and when using certain abilities. If winded, these actions will not be possible so keep an eye on it![/list]
[*]Life Shaper Relic progression updated
[list][*]Creature bonding/revival and creature building are now unlocked with two separate relics for smoother progression ramping[/list]
[*]Structure breaking updated
[list][*]A structure item will now will break with one hit for first 30 seconds after placed for quick recovery when misplacing or just changing your mind. (Afterwards, hit points and minimal break damage values will be used as per usual.)[/list][/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Attaching to a top of a block now faces forward by default
[*]Game crashing bugs caused by poachers fixed
[*]Frozen unresponsive poachers fixed
[*]Rain volume not impacted by options fixed[/list]
This is a work in progress. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/]Leave a post on the forums[/url] to let us know what you think so far!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/444aec98d27a9381c0dec404004bcf70afb6b81a.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Next Dev Stream: Community Workshop Creations![/b][/h1]
Since it’s a holiday here in the U.S. this week, our next developer stream will be on [url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=CHKN+Dev+Live+Stream&iso=20171122T1530&p1=179]Wednesday (Nov 22) @ 3:30 PM EST[/url]. Join us on [url=http://www.twitch.tv/chkngame]Twitch[/url] or [url=https://gaming.youtube.com/chknchannel/live]YouTube[/url] and show us your favorite creations!

See you then!

[i]- Team CHKN[/i]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/420930/CHKN/

notes.title: New Graphics Rendering: Pre-Release Sneak Peek
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/6585ebe13e3f8ef308da825842504ba3c70c17b3.jpg[/img]

Check out the awesome new lighting and rendering overhaul we just added to [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/305510202673028167/]Pre-Release[/url]! This change is step one to upgrade CHKN’s graphics and look & feel. We’re still tweaking so please let us know [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/]your feedback[/url], We think it looks pretty dang snazzy already so we wanted to share it with you first! (Click the screenshots below to see larger versions.)

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/3d00e389de581ef845c2632e1f0fcf10e7004afe.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/3d00e389de581ef845c2632e1f0fcf10e7004afe.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]Left is today’s game. Right is on Pre-Release. Note the lighting now has better detail (see horns) and sky is atmospheric (haze, clouds).[/i]

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/3d506abd3a679d8ebd08bc0f4508f9e941f6d17b.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/3d506abd3a679d8ebd08bc0f4508f9e941f6d17b.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]Venus flytrap in a new forest scene on Pre-Release (right). Fog effects plus color correction allows for warm night time atmosphere. Note the improved light reflecting off the eyes.[/i]

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/181ebf98f93ca34743478d14ceac90e77690b4b7.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/181ebf98f93ca34743478d14ceac90e77690b4b7.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]To the desert! The new skybox is in full effect (on right). The sunlight is scattered and reflected nicely off the beetle mouth... right before it bites your face.[/i]

Here are the technical details, if you’re into that sort of thing:
[list][*]Upgraded Visuals (Lighting, Colors, Rendering and Effects):
[list][*]Switched lighting from gamma to linear model to produce much more accurate and realistic lighting

notes.title: Help Test Controllers + Thanks for Bug Reports!
notes.content:
We need your help to test full controller support on Pre-Release. If you have a controller handy, here are the details:
[list][*]CHKN will now automatically detect when you have a controller connected. Woot!
[*]We’ve added cursor emulation so you can control those parts of the UI without needing a mouse.
[list][*]You can disable this emulation in the Options menu if you prefer the OS cursor, but heads up that this completely disables the ability to use parts of the UI with the controller and you’ll need to use a mouse, too.[/list]
[*]We’ve added default bindings for the following controllers (so far):
[list][*]Xbox 360
[*]Xbox One
[*]Playstation 3
[*]Playstation 4[/list]
[*]Steam Controller: Default bindings  are coming soon. In the meantime, you can set your own bindings (for any controller) in the Options -> Controls menu.[/list]
To download the Pre-Release build with controller support, check out [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/305510202673028167/]these instructions[/url]. Tell us about bugs, improvement ideas, or feedback on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/]the forums[/url] and we’ll take a look ASAP. Thank you!

[h1][b]New Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
Thanks to all your bug reports, we’ve updated the main live build with some bug fixes. Here are the patch notes:
[list][*]Fixed a bug that prevented saving new creatures to the Workshop
[*]Fix to UI errors when hosting a multiplayer game
[*]Fix to bad Adventure Mode starting point (that was causing players to appear on top of the temple instead of inside it)
[*]Fixed a bug that occured when all bindings were removed for a key that caused errors and conflicts across many systems (like creature building)
[*]Fixed bug that prevented beam creature revival
[*]Inventory and bonding screen can no longer be toggled when remote controlling a creature
[*]Improved charge ability collision detection
[*]Added check for duplicate blocks on host
[*]Added logic to place creature root in the correct position when the creature is reassembled
[*]Fixed floating legs on pause
[*]Fixed bug when placing blocks very quickly
[*]Fixed bug with saddle breaking all item usage
[*]Increased leg detection check range
[*]Added check for chain data being set on root chain before updating animations
[*]Added check to prevent rare client error message on creature death
[*]Various bug fixes across all game systems, mostly network related
[*]Fixed issue where tamed creatures would sometimes freeze after teleporting to player[/list]
[h1][b]Screenshots Now with New Ansel Support[/b][/h1]
[url=https://www.geforce.com/hardware/technology/ansel]nVidia Ansel[/url] is now available in CHKN! If you have a compatible nVidia video card and the latest graphics drivers, press ALT+F2 in-game to take fancy screenshots and even 360° views. Try it out!

[img]http://www.chkngame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/anselretroshot.png[/img]

Don’t forget to join us [url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=CHKN+Dev+Live+Stream&iso=20171020T1530&p1=179]Friday at 3:30 PM EST[/url] for our [url=http://gaming.youtube.com/chknchannel/live]dev live stream[/url], and [url=http://www.chkngame.com/getnewsletter]sign up for our newsletter[/url] to keep up with all our CHKN news.

More updates are on the way. See you then.

[i]- Team CHKN[/i]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/420930/CHKN/

notes.title: CHKN v0.4.4: Workshop & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[img]http://www.chkngame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/arena.gif[/img]

Since our the last update, we wanted to get out another patch with some bug fixes and improvements to the Workshop. You can post any feedback and/or bug reports on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/1/]the CHKN forums[/url] and we’ll take a look! Thank you!

[h1][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list][*]Workshop
[list][*]Workshop creatures and worlds can now be updated! Save your creation again to update the existing Workshop item (rather than create a new, duplicate entry).
[*]Creatures and worlds loaded from the Workshop can now only be saved by the original author of that creation
[*][url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=880401573]The Arena[/url] has been updated! All players in a multiplayer game can now participate in the challenge together. We’ve also fixed issues resulting from the structure changes that came along in patch v0.4.0.
[*]All worlds created before v0.4.0 have been removed from the “Community Nominated” list. (If you have any favorite worlds that should be spotlighted, share them in the comments below!)[/list]
[*]Creature legs will now always be level with the ground
[*]Added compression to network serialization to improve multiplayer performance[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list][*]Autosave now saves all chunks properly
[*]Fixed a crash bug involving navmesh generation when creating large structures
[*]Fixed problems with root swapping on creatures
[*]Fixed certain issues with the animation system’s tip and bend calculations
[*]Many bug fixes involving LUA scriptable blocks
[*]Fixed a bug that would move an item to the player from creatures
[*]Fixed issue with creature building over the network that would cause a desync between clients in multiplayer
[*]Fixed clients not being able to enter the edit orb in multiplayer
[*]Fixed network packet fragmentation to allow for massive structures
[*]Changed block removal to be more robust for clients
[*]Animation system now checks for null blocks for networked cases when in transition of removing blocks
[*]Fixed bug with bonded creatures which would cause them to freeze on death for clients in multiplayer games[/list]
Don’t forget to [url=http://www.chkngame.com/getnewsletter]sign up for our newsletter[/url] to be the first to hear about CHKN news!  And be sure to check out all the creative creations in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/workshop/]the Workshop[/url], and share your own!

[i]- Team CHKN[/i]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/420930/CHKN/

notes.title: CHKN v0.4.2: Creature Building & Controls!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/ac0241a6be47ad7434df04b813b122c63dd20511.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone! This release brings major improvements to creature building, as well as modified and new/added controls. We need your feedback on these changes! Please tell us what you like and what still needs improvement in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/1495615865216790527/]this forum thread[/url]. (And don’t worry if the new controls take some getting used to. They did for us, too!)

There are also some other neat things to play with in this update, like axe tossing and enrage potions and mounted attacks… just to name a few. (Pro tip: combine them all for a fun rampage.) Here are the patch notes!

[h1][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h1]
[b]New Features:[/b]
[list][*]Creature Building Improvements:
[list][*]The camera has been updated to make it much easier to see what you’re building!
[list][*]Camera now orbits the creature itself for a better 360° view
[*]Pivot around by using the [WASD] keys, or by holding your right mouse button and panning
[*]Camera pivot point can be changed by clicking [Mouse Button 3]
[*]Zoom in and out using the scroll wheel on your mouse, or by pressing the [+] and [-] keys[/list]

[img]http://www.chkngame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/buildrotate.gif[/img]
[i]Get a full view of your creature by rotating around it.[/i]

[*]The mouse cursor is now unlocked during creature building for faster block placement and selection!
[list][*]Select a Life Block by clicking on it in your hotbar
[*]Then just point and click where you want the block to go on your creature![/list]

[img]http://www.chkngame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/quickbuilding.gif[/img]
[i]Now use your mouse pointer to place blocks.[/i]

[*]Use [E] to quickly toggle between Add Block and Remove Block modes
[*]Added a new toolbar at the top of the screen with quick buttons for easy access to the various controls if you prefer using the mouse: building modes (add & remove), camera focus & reset, zooming, grid mode toggle (smart, small, off), creature name, and exiting build mode[/list]
[*]New Control Scheme: controls throughout the game are now easier to use
[list][*]Right-Click will now always use the off-hand item (Left-Click is still your main hand action)
[*]Throwing actions moved to a new key (default [Mouse Button 3] or [X].
[*]Contextual interactions like petting and feeding have moved to the interaction key [E].  In cases where multiple interaction are present holding interaction key will reveal a radial.
[*]Several items had their default actions modified to fit this scheme
[*]Removed the whistle item and changed it to be always available via key press (default [Q])
[*]Changed radial menu to be active as long as a button is held and dismiss on button release. Command is issued on key press up.[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/868936f357f9246cb7ef235c807569ea3d312b1d.png[/img]
[i]You can turn on the display (in the options menu) to see a helpful list of controls while you play.[/i]

[*]All items are now throwable! And any weapons you hurl will deal damage when they hit their targets.

[img]http://www.chkngame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/axewhoopsie.gif[/img]
[i]Just be sure to pick your targets wisely.[/i]

[*]Updated on-boarding in all modes for new control scheme/creature building
[*]Additional improvements to creature animation:
[list][*]Creature bodies will now naturally bend when turning
[*]Creature’s root block will now be recalculated based off of its actual center to create more realistic animations[/list]
[*]New feature: Remote Control! 
[list][*]Use the Remote Control to directly control tamed/bonded creatures via mind control[/list]

[img]http://www.chkngame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/remotecontrol.gif[/img]
[i]This Beetledodo is now yours to control! Muaa haa haaaa![/i]

[list][*]Automatically places a mind control hat on a creature. Destroying the hovering hat will release the controlled creature.
[*]Left click does light attacks (bites) and right click does special attacks (charge, fire breathing, etc) if a creature has that ability. Tapping shift will cause creature to dash.
[*]If a creature goes out of range, the connection is lost and control is returned back to the player. Interact key [E] will also exit control at any time.
[*]Life and hunger bars swap to reflect the controlled creature.
[*]When controlling a creature, the player is idle and vulnerable so be careful!
[*]Changed poachers to use new remote mechanic instead of mind control hat. (Poachers will now drop the Remote Control as loot instead of the hat.)[/list]
[*]Improved Saddle Riding:
[list][*]The first person camera is now smoother
[*]Improved chase (third-person) camera placement
[*]Mounted creatures will now show alongside other bonded creatures in the party UI[/list]
[*]Added player controlled creature combat while mounted:
[list][*]Two modes: indirect control (default) and direct control
[list][*]Indirect control: Set the direction and speed and your creature will navigate on its own from there, leaving you free to look around, use items, and even attack while mounted. (Tap the forward [W]/back [S] keys to increase/decrease speed.) [/list]

[img]http://www.chkngame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/saddleattacking.gif[/img]
[i]Let your creature do the driving while you attack![/i]

[list][*]Direct control: You have full control of the creature (but can’t use items this way). Use [WASD] to move, Left-Click to bite, and Right-Click for any special attacks the creature has. Dash by tapping shift.[/list]

[img]http://www.chkngame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/saddlecontrol.gif[/img]
[i]Take direct control of your creature while mounted to control its attacks.[/i]

[*]Change modes by pressing R by default
[*]Tapping [E] will pet or feed the creature
[*]Holding [E] will dismount[/list]
[*]Improved Pathfinding (Creature Navigation):
[list][*]Pathfinding now creates multiple navmeshes of different sizes. This allows creatures to more accurately transverse the environment.
[*]Creatures should clip through objects less often and should no longer get stuck on top of fences.[/list]
[*]New Potions: Antidote and Enrage!
[list][*]Antidote potion: cures all ailments! Drink it, toss it, or feed it to a creature.
[*]Enrage potion: causes a creature to temporarily go berserk and attack anything in range, even friends! Drink it yourself to get a damage buff for a short duration.[/list]
[*]Offset camera in chase cam slightly to the side when in locked mode to make it easier to see[/list]
[b]Optimizations:[/b]
[list][*]AI optimizations: FPS improvement in scenes with many active objects
[*]Smoother frame rates by reducing GC allocations (60fps on recommended spec machines, 30fps on minimum spec machines)
[*]Reduced FPS drop when loading new creatures
[*]Added item rotting and a max number of active items per chunk to improve performance (rotted items will not reload after leaving and then returning to a chunk)[/list]
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed creatures juggling their food instead of eating
[*]Fixed herbivores not eating fruits (Herbivores will also now eat plants that do not contain fruits.)
[*]Fixed bonded creatures freezing after teleporting
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented unsummoning a bonded creature in networked games
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented scenario spawning from working
[*]Fixed backward-facing darts when fired or thrown
[*]Fixed a bug where blowpipe darts failed to do damage
[*]Fixed various null exceptions that cause all sorts of unpredictable game errors
[*]Action button descriptions now use the bound keys (even if you’ve changed them from the defaults)
[*]Fixed several item hand alignments
[*]Fixed immortal poachers
[*]Improved chase camera crosshair raycasting
[*]Improved character look direction
[*]Fixed a bug where statuses (slowed, fire, etc) would not be removed correctly if loaded from a saved game
[*]Fixed issues with the dialog box
[*]Modified creature collision detection to allow bites on larger creatures
[*]Fixed bugs in sensing that prevented creatures from seeing other creatures
[*]Improved bonded creature teleportation to happen less often[/list]
[h1][b]Next Up![/b][/h1]
While we wait for your feedback on this release, we’ve already started on the next one! Here’s a bit of what’s coming in the next release:
[list][*][u]New Adventure Mode starting zone story, progression, and content:[/u] First 2 new biomes with new look and feel for environments and starter creatures, plus new lore and characters will unlock features and items for you as you progress.

[*][u]AI updates for new behaviors:[/u] creatures will play with each other, chase sticks, have more personality.

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/ac0241a6be47ad7434df04b813b122c63dd20511.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone! This release brings major improvements to creature building, as well as modified and new/added controls. We need your feedback on these changes! Please tell us what you like and what still needs improvement in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/4/1495615865216790527/]this forum thread[/url]. (And don’t worry if the new controls take some getting used to. They did for us, too!)

There are also some other neat things to play with in this update, like axe tossing and enrage potions and mounted attacks… just to name a few. (Pro tip: combine them all for a fun rampage.) Here are the patch notes!

[h1][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h1]
[b]New Features:[/b]
[list][*]Creature Building Improvements:
[list][*]The camera has been updated to make it much easier to see what you’re building!
[list][*]Camera now orbits the creature itself for a better 360° view
[*]Pivot around by using the [WASD] keys, or by holding your right mouse button and panning
[*]Camera pivot point can be changed by clicking [Mouse Button 3]
[*]Zoom in and out using the scroll wheel on your mouse, or by pressing the [+] and [-] keys[/list]

[img]http://www.chkngame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/buildrotate.gif[/img]
[i]Get a full view of your creature by rotating around it.[/i]

[*]The mouse cursor is now unlocked during creature building for faster block placement and selection!
[list][*]Select a Life Block by clicking on it in your hotbar
[*]Then just point and click where you want the block to go on your creature![/list]

[img]http://www.chkngame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/quickbuilding.gif[/img]
[i]Now use your mouse pointer to place blocks.[/i]

[*]Use [E] to quickly toggle between Add Block and Remove Block modes
[*]Added a new toolbar at the top of the screen with quick buttons for easy access to the various controls if you prefer using the mouse: building modes (add & remove), camera focus & reset, zooming, grid mode toggle (smart, small, off), creature name, and exiting build mode[/list]
[*]New Control Scheme: controls throughout the game are now easier to use
[list][*]Right-Click will now always use the off-hand item (Left-Click is still your main hand action)
[*]Throwing actions moved to a new key (default [Mouse Button 3] or [X].
[*]Contextual interactions like petting and feeding have moved to the interaction key [E].  In cases where multiple interaction are present holding interaction key will reveal a radial.
[*]Several items had their default actions modified to fit this scheme
[*]Removed the whistle item and changed it to be always available via key press (default [Q])
[*]Changed radial menu to be active as long as a button is held and dismiss on button release. Command is issued on key press up.[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/868936f357f9246cb7ef235c807569ea3d312b1d.png[/img]
[i]You can turn on the display (in the options menu) to see a helpful list of controls while you play.[/i]

[*]All items are now throwable! And any weapons you hurl will deal damage when they hit their targets.

[img]http://www.chkngame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/axewhoopsie.gif[/img]
[i]Just be sure to pick your targets wisely.[/i]

[*]Updated on-boarding in all modes for new control scheme/creature building
[*]Additional improvements to creature animation:
[list][*]Creature bodies will now naturally bend when turning
[*]Creature’s root block will now be recalculated based off of its actual center to create more realistic animations[/list]
[*]New feature: Remote Control! 
[list][*]Use the Remote Control to directly control tamed/bonded creatures via mind control[/list]

[img]http://www.chkngame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/remotecontrol.gif[/img]
[i]This Beetledodo is now yours to control! Muaa haa haaaa![/i]

[list][*]Automatically places a mind control hat on a creature. Destroying the hovering hat will release the controlled creature.
[*]Left click does light attacks (bites) and right click does special attacks (charge, fire breathing, etc) if a creature has that ability. Tapping shift will cause creature to dash.
[*]If a creature goes out of range, the connection is lost and control is returned back to the player. Interact key [E] will also exit control at any time.
[*]Life and hunger bars swap to reflect the controlled creature.
[*]When controlling a creature, the player is idle and vulnerable so be careful!
[*]Changed poachers to use new remote mechanic instead of mind control hat. (Poachers will now drop the Remote Control as loot instead of the hat.)[/list]
[*]Improved Saddle Riding:
[list][*]The first person camera is now smoother
[*]Improved chase (third-person) camera placement
[*]Mounted creatures will now show alongside other bonded creatures in the party UI[/list]
[*]Added player controlled creature combat while mounted:
[list][*]Two modes: indirect control (default) and direct control
[list][*]Indirect control: Set the direction and speed and your creature will navigate on its own from there, leaving you free to look around, use items, and even attack while mounted. (Tap the forward [W]/back [S] keys to increase/decrease speed.) [/list]

[img]http://www.chkngame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/saddleattacking.gif[/img]
[i]Let your creature do the driving while you attack![/i]

[list][*]Direct control: You have full control of the creature (but can’t use items this way). Use [WASD] to move, Left-Click to bite, and Right-Click for any special attacks the creature has. Dash by tapping shift.[/list]

[img]http://www.chkngame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/saddlecontrol.gif[/img]
[i]Take direct control of your creature while mounted to control its attacks.[/i]

[*]Change modes by pressing R by default
[*]Tapping [E] will pet or feed the creature
[*]Holding [E] will dismount[/list]
[*]Improved Pathfinding (Creature Navigation):
[list][*]Pathfinding now creates multiple navmeshes of different sizes. This allows creatures to more accurately transverse the environment.
[*]Creatures should clip through objects less often and should no longer get stuck on top of fences.[/list]
[*]New Potions: Antidote and Enrage!
[list][*]Antidote potion: cures all ailments! Drink it, toss it, or feed it to a creature.
[*]Enrage potion: causes a creature to temporarily go berserk and attack anything in range, even friends! Drink it yourself to get a damage buff for a short duration.[/list]
[*]Offset camera in chase cam slightly to the side when in locked mode to make it easier to see[/list]
[b]Optimizations:[/b]
[list][*]AI optimizations: FPS improvement in scenes with many active objects
[*]Smoother frame rates by reducing GC allocations (60fps on recommended spec machines, 30fps on minimum spec machines)
[*]Reduced FPS drop when loading new creatures

[*]Fixed a bug where statuses (slowed, fire, etc) would not be removed correctly if loaded from a saved game
[*]Fixed issues with the dialog box
[*]Modified creature collision detection to allow bites on larger creatures
[*]Fixed bugs in sensing that prevented creatures from seeing other creatures

In the meantime, we’ll be putting out an interim update with [u]controller support[/u]. Keep an eye out for that if you’ve been waiting to use a controller in CHKN!

Until then, check out our [url=https://trello.com/b/GgeN5g3B/chkn-epic-development-board]Roadmap[/url] to see what we’re working on. [url=http://www.chkngame.com/getnewsletter]Sign up[/url] to be the first to get CHKN developer news. 

Join us on [url=http://www.twitch.tv/chkngame]Twitch[/url]/[url=http://www.youtube.com/chknchannel]YouTube[/url] for our developer live stream on Friday at [url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=CHKN+Dev+Live+Stream&iso=20170929T1530&p1=179]3:30PM EST[/url].

notes.title: CHKN v0.4.1: Creature AI Update is Here!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.chkngame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/chickenapproach.gif[/img]
[i]Updated animations (like this chicken reaching down for food in a more life-like way) are new, too![/i]

It’s patch day! We’ve got some major overhauls to creature AI and the animation system, to make creatures more intelligent. We’ve set the foundations for matching gameplay to our big vision for CHKN - make the world really come to life. We want to give players full control of their creativity to build anything they want and discover new behaviors and abilities along the way based on YOUR choices of which Life Blocks you use and how you put them together. A chickpigocrab will cluck, eat anything, and have dangerous pincers to protect itself, exactly how you imagine it would. Today, with this update, creatures are smarter, more responsive to you (the player) and the world around them, and look more life-like. 

The full patch notes are just below. We’ve also got details on what’s next on our roadmap at the bottom of this post!

[h1][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][u][b]Animation System Improvements:[/b][/u]
[list][*]Tween-based animation added: Animations are smoother, more life-like, and better portray a creature’s behaviors and emotions.
[list][*]Since the animations are tied to the AI, this helps differentiate a creature’s behaviors so you can more easily make sense of its intentions. Is it curious about a sound it just heard that needs investigating? Or is it angry and about to charge and attack? These are good things to know when you’re trying to survive!
[*]To start, creatures will now strike and flinch, which are responses to anger and fear. They can also kneel to reach food or go to sleep (which is super cute, btw). Future animations are now easier to add so more animations, including part-specific ones like pinching crab claws, are on the way!
[*]Creatures now have different ways to orientate their necks. They can position them up right and face what they are looking at or move them in closely to reach. They will use the reach mode to eat food and to get close to things like the player as they approach.
[*]Spines and other connected blocks will now move more naturally and react with the feet. Feet are also now better connect to the ground, making walking animations look much more natural.[/list][/list]

[img]http://www.chkngame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/surprisedgiraffe.gif[/img]
[i]Flinching, better neck movement, and threat assessment… all new in this update![/i]

[list][*]Independent “chain” control: Chains are a row of blocks linked together, like in a neck for example. Each chain can now move independently, so chains with eyes on the end will look while chains with mouths will eat and strike. This means even individual blocks with eyes attached can now rotate and look around, making it much easier for you to tell what your creature is paying attention to!
[*]Initial posturing added: This is a fancy way of saying that creatures look and move at different speeds if they are relaxed compared to alert. A creature wary of nearby enemies will look around more quickly in an alert state compared to a mellow creature snacking on a burger.[/list]

[*][b][u]New Creature AI:[/u][/b]
[list][*]New & Improved Sensing System:
[list][*]Hearing added! Creatures can now hear and react to sounds, like other creatures coming up behind them or rocks thrown to distract them while you sneak by. Shhh…[/list][/list]

[img]http://www.chkngame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/beforeandafter_soundai.gif[/img]
[i]Before: The creature has no idea what might be going on behind it.
After: “I HEARD SOMETHING DELICIOUS!”[/i]

[list][list][*]Sight has been greatly improved, now taking into account exposure, lighting, and movement. Some creatures have a harder time seeing at night, while others like the cat, will have better vision at night. This new sight system also makes it possible to do things like hide from aggressive creatures in tall grasses under the right circumstances. Sneaky![/list][/list]

[img]http://www.chkngame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/dragonvision_avatar.gif[/img]
[i]What a dragon’s senses look like to developers! The yellow “cone” is the dragon following us with his eyes as we move.[/i]

[list][*]Improved creature decision making:
[list][*]Creatures take in all that new sensing info to recognize more of what’s happening around them and react to it intelligently (or not; some creatures will be smarter than others!).
[*]This means better, more precise interactions with the world, objects, and other creatures!
[*]This will also allow us to add more intelligent (and surprising) behaviors in the future! An elephant will see a fire, recognize that it’s dangerous, and then react on its own to put it out without needing your command.[/list][/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/fd4b63f4751c3afe709947c076331179127ef19c.jpg[/img]
[i]Instead of limited, hard-coded behaviors, creatures now have brains and make their own decisions.[/i]

[list][*]New pathfinding system: This improves creature navigation as well as performance throughout the game. They can follow you and find their way around terrain more easily![/list][/list]
[*][b][u]Smarter Creature Attacks + Player Dodge =  Improved Combat:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Creature striking added: leveraging the power of the new animation system, creatures will now prime (pull back slightly) and then strike to attack!
[*]Added creature flinching: Dealing enough damage in a single attack will cause a creature to flinch. Flinching will interrupt a creature’s attack![/list]

[img]http://www.chkngame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/catstrikeflinch.gif[/img]
[i]He really, really didn’t expect you to interrupt his attack.[/i]

[list][*]Dodge player ability added: Now that creatures can strike, it’s only right that you be able to avoid it... if you time things right. ;) Tap the Sprint key ([SHIFT] by default) to roll in the direction you’re moving and avoid damage.[/list]

[img]http://www.chkngame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/tuckandroll.gif[/img]
[i]Or dodge fire. Dodging the fire is always a good idea.[/i]

[list][*]Added creature-to-creature collision: Creatures will push each other around based on their mass. You might want to strategize if your smaller creatures are going up against a larger one!
[*]Added attack knockback: Based off the amount of damage done, a creature can now be staggered into a direction.
[*]Added creature dashing: Creatures can now dash forward or back in order to get into a good attack position or avoid an incoming attack. Beware![/list]

[img]http://www.chkngame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/turtledash.gif[/img]
[i]Dash and dodge.[/i]

[list][*]Updated creature damage detection: This is now physically accurate and takes other things (besides the target) into account, so objects like trees and other creatures can get in the way of an incoming attack. Run for cover behind your creature to shield yourself from damage!
[*]Third-person camera improvements: The camera is now locked in the direction you’re facing when in combat, making it easier to keep your eye on enemy creatures and any incoming attacks. This also improves aiming with ranged weapons. (The camera remains in free orbit as usual when out of combat.)[/list][/list]
[*][b][u]Multiplayer Improvements (Live for Testing):[/u][/b]
[list][*]You can now turn “tethering” off in the options menu! When turned off, multiplayer clients can roam away from the host and wander the world. This is one of the biggest requests we’ve gotten so we’ve done some research and optimization to allow this option.
[list][*][b]Warning:[/b] You may experience FPS drops and lag when traveling far from friends, especially flying around in Creative Mode. Please send us your feedback! We will continue to improve performance in the next update.
[*]If you have any framerate issues or you just like keeping everyone together, you can turn this back on whenever you like in the options menu.[/list]
[*]Increased tether range when active
[*]Updated to latest version of multiplayer framework to improve stability
[*]Players’ heads will now rotate in the direction that they are looking
[*]Reduced max players to 4 to help improve performance
[*]Added support for multiple saddle riding on one creature![/list]

[img]http://www.chkngame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/dragonmultiride.gif[/img]
[i]Dragon riding is better with friends.[/i]

[*][b][u]Performance Optimizations:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Additional chunk loading optimization
[*]Cached terrain detail optimizations[/list]

[*][b][u]Bug Fixes:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Fix to relic floating: it will no longer get stuck in the air or underground if built over
[*]Fix to a bug that prevented resurrecting creatures in beams in some cases
[*]Fix to “unlimited items” crafting bug after canceling an item’s progress mid-craft
[*]Fix to mono runtime, which would cause game to crash when a chunk unloads
[*]Fix to angler fish lure’s dynamic physics
[*]Fix to removing structures by nuke for clients
[*]Fix to placeable entities not appearing for clients[/list][/list]

[h1][b]Coming Soon on Our Roadmap![/b][/h1]
Now that creatures are more intelligent and the animation system is ready, we can add more variety and creature enhancements. Our next task will be giving all 140+ current Life Blocks unique tuning stats and hidden abilities, while keeping recognizable traits from their inspirational animals, so you can experiment and find meaningful combinations. Then we’ll add EVEN MORE Life Blocks and creatures. We also want to focus on Adventure Mode and the overall look & feel of the game.

[b]Some big updates coming this year:[/b]

[list][*][u][b]Creature Intelligence:[/b][/u] New creature behaviors will take the experience to a full ecosystem.
[list][*]More animated behaviors, and skills (stealth and camouflage top the list thanks to your feedback, plus unique creature skills like dogs hearing really well and spiders shooting webs, etc.)[/list]
[*][u][b]Player Controls:[/b][/u] New intuitive controls and UI will improve usability.
[list][*]Creature building upgrades: easier life block selection and building, improved camera, more rotation options
[*]Action hot bar replaces item shortcuts
[*]Improved UI for inventory and item storage, toolbox, off-hand items
[*]Full Controller support[/list]
[*][u][b]New Introduction to Adventure:[/b][/u] Story, progression, and content!
[list][*]The mysteries of CHKN will be illuminated by playing Adventure Mode. New lore and characters will unlock features and items for you as you progress.
[*]First 2 new biomes with new look and feel for environments and starter creatures
[*]New Biome progression and art. Biomes will blend naturally and contain creatures and items that are integral to those environments. (ex: Palm Trees, crabs, and crab hybrids will only be found on beaches.)[/list]
[*][u][b]On-going:[/b][/u] performance improvements and, of course, your feedback! We’re also looking at the Workshop for your ideas and where we can add support for your content creation, too.[/list]
We won’t stop there, though. You can see even more of what we have in store for CHKN on our [url=https://trello.com/b/GgeN5g3B/chkn-epic-development-board]Roadmap[/url]. And if there’s anything you’d like to see in the game, please feel free to [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/2/]share it with us[/url]! Hearing your feedback and suggestions really helps make CHKN even better.

Don’t forget to join us for this week’s developer live stream over on [url=http://www.twitch.tv/chkngame]Twitch[/url] on Friday at [url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=CHKN+Dev+Live+Stream&iso=20170901T13&p1=179]1PM EST[/url]. 

Make sure to subscribe to our [url=https://www.youtube.com/chknchannel]CHKN YouTube channel[/url]! You can check out the latest gameplay videos, and playlists featuring some of our favorites from [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLVOfKuEH7nbMQHxkWEpByKJabu6vAEMiT]SpyCakes[/url] & [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A8hON2xWJn0]Beautiful O.B[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL4_8WHOfa6qnHQq2PGrJLLqKsy94hOpYH]Holly Huntress[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLJHppwngy77XCUmJWHCdUf6NcWn3pKLFr]Ariona Gamer[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLDU90X9MIwZOmsr4HzpzYeMolTcUijnet]Ryland & PolemicGoblin[/url], and more. Just click subscribe to get updates from CHKN.

We hope you enjoy this update! Until next time...

[i]- Team CHKN[/i]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/420930/CHKN/

[*]Initial posturing added: This is a fancy way of saying that creatures look and move at different speeds if they are relaxed compared to alert. A creature wary of nearby enemies will look around more quickly in an alert state compared to a mellow creature snacking on a burger.[/list]

[*][b][u]New Creature AI:[/u][/b]
[list][*]New & Improved Sensing System:
[list][*]Hearing added! Creatures can now hear and react to sounds, like other creatures coming up behind them or rocks thrown to distract them while you sneak by. Shhh…[/list][/list]

[img]http://www.chkngame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/beforeandafter_soundai.gif[/img]
[i]Before: The creature has no idea what might be going on behind it.
After: “I HEARD SOMETHING DELICIOUS!”[/i]

[list][list][*]Sight has been greatly improved, now taking into account exposure, lighting, and movement. Some creatures have a harder time seeing at night, while others like the cat, will have better vision at night. This new sight system also makes it possible to do things like hide from aggressive creatures in tall grasses under the right circumstances. Sneaky![/list][/list]

[img]http://www.chkngame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/dragonvision_avatar.gif[/img]
[i]What a dragon’s senses look like to developers! The yellow “cone” is the dragon following us with his eyes as we move.[/i]

[list][*]Improved creature decision making:
[list][*]Creatures take in all that new sensing info to recognize more of what’s happening around them and react to it intelligently (or not; some creatures will be smarter than others!).
[*]This means better, more precise interactions with the world, objects, and other creatures!
[*]This will also allow us to add more intelligent (and surprising) behaviors in the future! An elephant will see a fire, recognize that it’s dangerous, and then react on its own to put it out without needing your command.[/list][/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11903998/fd4b63f4751c3afe709947c076331179127ef19c.jpg[/img]
[i]Instead of limited, hard-coded behaviors, creatures now have brains and make their own decisions.[/i]

[list][*]New pathfinding system: This improves creature navigation as well as performance throughout the game. They can follow you and find their way around terrain more easily![/list][/list]
[*][b][u]Smarter Creature Attacks + Player Dodge =  Improved Combat:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Creature striking added: leveraging the power of the new animation system, creatures will now prime (pull back slightly) and then strike to attack!
[*]Added creature flinching: Dealing enough damage in a single attack will cause a creature to flinch. Flinching will interrupt a creature’s attack![/list]

[img]http://www.chkngame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/catstrikeflinch.gif[/img]
[i]He really, really didn’t expect you to interrupt his attack.[/i]

[list][*]Dodge player ability added: Now that creatures can strike, it’s only right that you be able to avoid it... if you time things right. ;) Tap the Sprint key ([SHIFT] by default) to roll in the direction you’re moving and avoid damage.[/list]

[img]http://www.chkngame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/tuckandroll.gif[/img]
[i]Or dodge fire. Dodging the fire is always a good idea.[/i]

[list][*]Added creature-to-creature collision: Creatures will push each other around based on their mass. You might want to strategize if your smaller creatures are going up against a larger one!
[*]Added attack knockback: Based off the amount of damage done, a creature can now be staggered into a direction.
[*]Added creature dashing: Creatures can now dash forward or back in order to get into a good attack position or avoid an incoming attack. Beware![/list]

[img]http://www.chkngame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/turtledash.gif[/img]
[i]Dash and dodge.[/i]

[list][*]Updated creature damage detection: This is now physically accurate and takes other things (besides the target) into account, so objects like trees and other creatures can get in the way of an incoming attack. Run for cover behind your creature to shield yourself from damage!
[*]Third-person camera improvements: The camera is now locked in the direction you’re facing when in combat, making it easier to keep your eye on enemy creatures and any incoming attacks. This also improves aiming with ranged weapons. (The camera remains in free orbit as usual when out of combat.)[/list][/list]
[*][b][u]Multiplayer Improvements (Live for Testing):[/u][/b]
[list][*]You can now turn “tethering” off in the options menu! When turned off, multiplayer clients can roam away from the host and wander the world. This is one of the biggest requests we’ve gotten so we’ve done some research and optimization to allow this option.
[list][*][b]Warning:[/b] You may experience FPS drops and lag when traveling far from friends, especially flying around in Creative Mode. Please send us your feedback! We will continue to improve performance in the next update.
[*]If you have any framerate issues or you just like keeping everyone together, you can turn this back on whenever you like in the options menu.[/list]
[*]Increased tether range when active
[*]Updated to latest version of multiplayer framework to improve stability
[*]Players’ heads will now rotate in the direction that they are looking
[*]Reduced max players to 4 to help improve performance
[*]Added support for multiple saddle riding on one creature![/list]

[img]http://www.chkngame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/dragonmultiride.gif[/img]
[i]Dragon riding is better with friends.[/i]

[*][b][u]Performance Optimizations:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Additional chunk loading optimization
[*]Cached terrain detail optimizations[/list]

[*][b][u]Bug Fixes:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Fix to relic floating: it will no longer get stuck in the air or underground if built over
[*]Fix to a bug that prevented resurrecting creatures in beams in some cases
[*]Fix to “unlimited items” crafting bug after canceling an item’s progress mid-craft
[*]Fix to mono runtime, which would cause game to crash when a chunk unloads
[*]Fix to angler fish lure’s dynamic physics
[*]Fix to removing structures by nuke for clients
[*]Fix to placeable entities not appearing for clients[/list][/list]

[h1][b]Coming Soon on Our Roadmap![/b][/h1]
Now that creatures are more intelligent and the animation system is ready, we can add more variety and creature enhancements. Our next task will be giving all 140+ current Life Blocks unique tuning stats and hidden abilities, while keeping recognizable traits from their inspirational animals, so you can experiment and find meaningful combinations. Then we’ll add EVEN MORE Life Blocks and creatures. We also want to focus on Adventure Mode and the overall look & feel of the game.

[b]Some big updates coming this year:[/b]

[list][*][u][b]Creature Intelligence:[/b][/u] New creature behaviors will take the experience to a full ecosystem.
[list][*]More animated behaviors, and skills (stealth and camouflage top the list thanks to your feedback, plus unique creature skills like dogs hearing really well and spiders shooting webs, etc.)[/list]
[*][u][b]Player Controls:[/b][/u] New intuitive controls and UI will improve usability.
[list][*]Creature building upgrades: easier life block selection and building, improved camera, more rotation options
[*]Action hot bar replaces item shortcuts
[*]Improved UI for inventory and item storage, toolbox, off-hand items
[*]Full Controller support[/list]
[*][u][b]New Introduction to Adventure:[/b][/u] Story, progression, and content!
[list][*]The mysteries of CHKN will be illuminated by playing Adventure Mode. New lore and characters will unlock features and items for you as you progress.
[*]First 2 new biomes with new look and feel for environments and starter creatures
[*]New Biome progression and art. Biomes will blend naturally and contain creatures and items that are integral to those environments. (ex: Palm Trees, crabs, and crab hybrids will only be found on beaches.)[/list]
[*][u][b]On-going:[/b][/u] performance improvements and, of course, your feedback! We’re also looking at the Workshop for your ideas and where we can add support for your content creation, too.[/list]
We won’t stop there, though. You can see even more of what we have in store for CHKN on our [url=https://trello.com/b/GgeN5g3B/chkn-epic-development-board]Roadmap[/url]. And if there’s anything you’d like to see in the game, please feel free to [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420930/discussions/2/]share it with us[/url]! Hearing your feedback and suggestions really helps make CHKN even better.

Don’t forget to join us for this week’s developer live stream over on [url=http://www.twitch.tv/chkngame]Twitch[/url] on Friday at [url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=CHKN+Dev+Live+Stream&iso=20170901T13&p1=179]1PM EST[/url]. 

Make sure to subscribe to our [url=https://www.youtube.com/chknchannel]CHKN YouTube channel[/url]! You can check out the latest gameplay videos, and playlists featuring some of our favorites from [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLVOfKuEH7nbMQHxkWEpByKJabu6vAEMiT]SpyCakes[/url] & [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A8hON2xWJn0]Beautiful O.B[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL4_8WHOfa6qnHQq2PGrJLLqKsy94hOpYH]Holly Huntress[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLJHppwngy77XCUmJWHCdUf6NcWn3pKLFr]Ariona Gamer[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLDU90X9MIwZOmsr4HzpzYeMolTcUijnet]Ryland & PolemicGoblin[/url], and more. Just click subscribe to get updates from CHKN.

We hope you enjoy this update! Until next time...

[i]- Team CHKN[/i]
