[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/5728e7df1d07c0c3d31149f4/1462298593017/Screen+Shot+2016-05-02+at+6.48.55+PM.png?format=750w[/img]

We have a new creature in the works and this time, we wanted you to guess what it is! We want to do this from now on, and give you a few helpful, interesting hints and a silhouette to guess from. (Remember before every commercial break on Pokemon when you had to guess which one it was? Kinds like that...but creepier.)
[olist]
[*]It lives in bogs. EW.
[*]Don't fall in! It's speedy maw opens and closes in only a few milliseconds, trapping mostly bugs but sometimes the occasional frog. 
[*]Although it looks like they have teeth, they actually have trigger hairs, which snap shut when stimulated![/olist]

[h1]Comment your answers!! We will reveal the answer next week![/h1]

notes.title: Patch Notes for v0.1.04: Achievements, Glow Sphere, and Faster Loading!
notes.content:
[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/571fb37c40261d593049e0cd/1461695439974/?format=1000w[/img]

The achievements are here, woohoo! Some other highlights include faster load time, a new loading screen, illuminated edit orb, and no more continued clicking! You ask and you shall receive. Here are the rest of the patch notes.

[h1]NEW FEATURES:[/h1]
[list][*]First set of achievements added.[/list]

[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/571fb07bc6fc0839be6066b1/1461694589797/?format=750w[/img]

[h1]IMPROVEMENTS:[/h1]
[list]
[*]App startup time reduced and optimized.
[*]New loading screen added.
[*]"Pick up all" button added to loot sack and chests.
[*]Player health increased by a factor of 2.5.
[*]Striking does not require continuous clicking anymore.
[*]Creatures now follow whistle commands when in a happy state.
[*]The pitch of creature sounds are now affected by its size.
[*]New cat meshes.
[*]Edit orb now emits light.
[*]Sounds added to the slingshot.
[*]Slingshot ammo crafting yield increased.
[*]Creature AI now reach properly to ranged attacks.
[*]Added graphic settings to the options screen. Automatic setting will choose the optimum setting based off of frame rate. [/list]
[b]PLEASE NOTE[/b] This setting overrides what you choose when you launch the game. You will have to go into options once you are in the game to choose which graphics quality you prefer. We are going to work more on this.

[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/571fb0332fe13140bbcf3805/1461694527524/?format=1000w[/img]

[h1]FIXES:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed roof structure colliders.
[*]Fixed ruin colliders.
[*]Slingshot no longer shots multiple rocks at a time.
[*]Slingshot ammo can now be picked up. 
[*]Taming on boarding messages now give correct feedback.
[*]Fix to eye rotation on saved creatures.
[*]Bug fixes with picking up items with durability.[/list]

notes.title: Dev Log: PAX East Round Up!
notes.content:
[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/571e850af699bbf2e006a3dc/1461617940275/?format=1000w[/img]

[h1]Hey CHKN Army![/h1]

Roman and Kate are back from PAX East! What an adventure. Here are some of the highlights!

Kate and Roman met [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/MattShea369]Matt Shea[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/draegast]Draegast[/url], and gave them some CHKN t-shirts as a thank you for supporting us since day one. They were both fun and down to earth, and gave us great advice on how to make CHKN even better, including ideas on bosses and water physics. Matt Shea does not like our water LOL.

[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/571e85f97da24ffc7388561e/1461618172795/?format=1000w[/img]

Kate also ran (literally) into [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/CurriePlays]Currieplays[/url] while walking through the Expo Floor. He was so nice and so enthusiastic (and so tall). We also got some great requests from him as well, including better multiplayer and weirder creatures. He also got some CHKN swag and started wearing it already!

[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/571e86d7ab48de1a6d5ba181/571e86d720c647f92a2ae0c2/1461618403155/Screen+Shot+2016-04-25+at+5.06.20+PM.png?format=500w[/img][img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/571e86d7ab48de1a6d5ba181/571e86e2ab48de1a6d5ba1db/1461618413697/Slack+for+iOS+Upload.jpg?format=500w[/img]

Roman and Kate were invited to a Curse Happy Hour where they meet some free-lance writers and some Cure employees that they had only talked to via email before, which was fun. 

Kate also attended at IGN/Battleborn party where she mets some amazing writers from IGN. They were seriously the nicest people, and some had even heard of CHKN. Woohooo!

[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/571e8752d51cd40a84cff0ba/1461618521065/?format=1000w[/img]

Whelp, we survived the mayhem that is PAX and are now safely back in New York City. Now, back to work!

[i]Sincerely,

Team CHKN.[/i]

notes.title: Dev Log: PAX East, Achievements, + The May Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey CHKN Army![/h1]

Lots of news in this weeks dev log. Get comfy, you're in for a treat.

Monday we have an update coming, which includes achievements! You ask and we shall deliver. This is a first round of achievements and more will come later. Some include:

[list][*][b]Caveman[/b]: Made a tool.
[*][b]Yippee Ki Yay[/b]: Rode a creature.
[*][b]Best Buds[/b]: Tamed a creature.[/list]

[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/5718fb6be32140e5757dddbc/1461255026926/?format=750w[/img]

Roman and Kate are off to PAX East tomorrow! We plan on meeting a lot of great YouTubers and industry leaders, so make sure you follow [url=https://twitter.com/chkngame]CHKN on Twitter[/url] to see what they're up to. Are we ready for all these crowds? That's up for debate. *BREATHE IN....BREATHE OUT....*

[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/5718f728859fd044de1e9f57/1461253965463/?format=750w[/img]

[h1]"THE MAY UPDATE"[/h1]

Since our launch in April we have gotten amazing feedback, suggestions and criticisms. The CHKN Army is full of passionate gamers, writers, critics, fellow devs and also students. So Team CHKN huddled weekly, drank gallons of coffee, pep talked each other and did some planning, and we have a pretty solid update coming very soon for you guys. Here are some of the highlights:
[list]
[*]Greatly improved Multiplayer, with easier ways to connect with your friends. (No more ports! Rejoice!)
[*]At least 5 new creatures! The llama, sheep and the goat, including a few other surprises. 
[*]"More stuff to do", as many have eloquently requested. 
[*]Clarification on interacting with your creatures, both in the interface and the experience.[/list]

We also are planning on including you guys even more, such as streaming with a guest from the community! There will be more information as we push onwards towards May. But first...battling the crowds at PAX, implementing achievements, and improving performance and load times. Let's get crackin!

notes.title: Dev Log: New Creature + Troubleshooting Guide!
notes.content:
[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/570c0a335559869747b523c4/1460406845563/?format=1000w[/img]

[h1]HEY GUYS![/h1]
How's everyone doing? We skipped a dev log by accident, so we want to update you on what we've been up to and what we are working on!

We finished the sheep! He looks like an animal version of a dorky younger brother. We are also working on a llama and a goat to be released at the same time as the sheep. It's like a slow, slobbery and fluffy farm animal pack. 

Here's a really creepy early look at the llama. THOSE EYES HAVE SEEN THINGS.

[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/570c34d501dbae356ab1dff7/1460417756385/?format=500w[/img]

We also added a [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=661806121]troubleshooting guide[/url] for CHKN. If you are having problems starting the game or with crashing, you should [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=661806121]read the guide[/url]. Usually the problems are really simple to fix, like updating your drivers or your operating system.

Roman and Kate will be attending Pax East 2016 this month as well! If you are a developer, gamer, YouTuber or CHKN fan and you are attending, [url=https://twitter.com/chkngame]Tweet at us[/url] and we'd love to meet you!

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.1.02 Beta
notes.content:
[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/570323b2f850820e70bedfb4/1459823694465/?format=1000w[/img]

Another installment of Late Night Patch Notes!!

Now that CHKN has been released, we decided that at the very least we will be releasing builds every two weeks. However, we continually make small patches, which we will announce whenever it happens (like at 10:39 PM on a Monday). So, here are the notes for 0.1.02!
[list] 
[*]stability fixes.
[*]added collider to log.
[*]creatures now eat eggs, melons, squash, and feed grass plants.
[*]players can now harvest feed grass.
[*]tweak to creature pursue speed.
[*]fix to saddle riding and leash conflict.
[*]creature attachable items no longer attach to structures.
[*]chests are now removed correctly from data.
[*]creature edit mode front arrow indicator can now be seen in the dark.
[*]edit orb will fail if any untamed creatures are present. 
[*]fixes to item icons.
[*]fixes to instructional text misspellings. [/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.1.02 Beta
notes.content:
[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/570323b2f850820e70bedfb4/1459823694465/?format=1000w[/img]

Another installment of Late Night Patch Notes!!

Now that CHKN has been released, we decided that at the very least we will be releasing builds every two weeks. However, we continually make small patches, which we will announce whenever it happens (like at 10:39 PM on a Monday). So, here are the notes for 0.1.02!
[list] 
[*]stability fixes.
[*]added collider to log.
[*]creatures now eat eggs, melons, squash, and feed grass plants.
[*]players can now harvest feed grass.
[*]tweak to creature pursue speed.
[*]fix to saddle riding and leash conflict.
[*]creature attachable items no longer attach to structures.
[*]chests are now removed correctly from data.
[*]creature edit mode front arrow indicator can now be seen in the dark.
[*]edit orb will fail if any untamed creatures are present. 
[*]fixes to item icons.
[*]fixes to instructional text misspellings. [/list]

notes.title: CHKN IS NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/56fe9917f699bb08d8bee513/1459525915739/?format=750w[/img]

Exactly a year ago John and Roman had this crazy idea to make a game about building creatures that have intelligence. One year later, our game (and our team) has morphed from four people working on a tech demo to ten people releasing CHKN on Early Access. What a year it's been!

Team CHKN would like to thank anyone who made a video, sent us feedback, laughed at our weirdness, made amazing creatures, helped us get Greenlit, voted for us on IndieDB and stayed with us from the beginning or just joined us today!  We have an even crazier road ahead of us and we are excited to have you along for the ride. 

[h1]PATCH NOTES FOR v0.1.0:[/h1]
[list]
[*]fix to life block rotations.
[*]fix to missing chunks.
[*]limbs now attach to limbs correctly.
[*]saves more robust.
[*]bed sets respawn point.
[*]squash item offset fixed.
[*]loot bag doesn't spawn if no items in inventory.
[*]fix to furnace, chest, doors, workbench, campfire, fruit iterations. 
[*]fix to unlimited items.
[*]chemistry table removed for now, since it wasn't working yet.
[*]pet tag offset fixed.
[*]renamed items with correct names.
[*]fix to tree fruits that were not showing.
[*]allow editing of untamed creatures in creative mode.
[*]crafting UI optimized and polished. [/list]

notes.title: [Beta Testers] Release Candidate Patch Notes: v0.1.0 RC.
notes.content:
[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/56fd5ba9859fd00606f7fd3d/1459444668438/CreatureParty.gif?format=500w[/img]
CREATURE PARTY.

[h1]Hey Beta Testers![/h1]

We have a release candidate build on Steam. We are one day away and we would like your help working out any final kinks! We changed a lot, our egg is about to hatch into an actual game. *screams internally*. 

Here are the patch notes for the release candidate build:
[list][*]Underwater effects, swimming and drowning added. 
[*]Pet and slap buttons swapped.
[*]Performance optimizations.
[*]Fruits now spawn every 20 minutes.
[*]Creature species memories reset with new game.
[*]Water now lit properly.
[*]Ambient environment sounds added.
[*]Fixes to saddle riding. 
[*]Fixes to creature movement speed calculation.
[*]Player should no longer respawn in dead animation state. 
[*]Loading screen added as game loads from a save.
[*]Fire sound effects added.
[*] bug where everything would be set on fire resolved. 
[*]Lantern orientation in players hand fixed.
[*]Removed starvation, day/night cycle, drowning, and stamina from creative mode.
[*]Torches now degrade with use.
[*]Torches and fire go out underwater.
[*]Vine now degrades when used as a leash.
[*]Tree trunks no longer preview
[*]Creative Mode creature egg now creates all creatures, and at random.
[*]Added item tab filters to creative mode inventory.
[*]Added two slash commands; /time 0-24 (each number is an hour of progression), /mode creative or adventure. Use enter to bring up input menu.
[*]AI now takes into account creatures speed when pursuing a target. 
[*]Fix to null error break networking. 
[*]Fix to life block rotations.
[*]Food restores health in creative mode.
[*]Added multiple save states. [/list]

If any of you beta testers have a chance to play, please let us know in the forum if you have any issues! See you tomorrow when we release! AAAAAAHHHH!!!!

[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/56fd51977c65e4e1d1cbe483/1459442109041/?format=1000w[/img]
New creative mode onboarding and tutorial prompts.

[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/56fd58ae859fd00606f7e0a4/1459444832346/?format=1000w[/img]
Eggs now spawn every type of creature at random.

notes.title: Dev Log + Patch Notes for Beta Build v0.0.95.
notes.content:
[h1]WE'RE BACK FROM GDC! WHAT ARE WE UP TO NOW?[/h1]

We've slept off the jet lag and came out of our In-and-Out Burger induced comas and are ready for the final stretch. We release next Friday!

Today we released a build to the beta testers that fixes a few major problems we saw a lot of players having. One is that when players died, they would lose all their loot! Now we added a loot bag to keep body parts and torches and doors in. How does that all fit, you ask? WELL STAHP. IT'S A SECRET.

[img]https://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/56f4411ec6fc0896abc34252/1458848058246/?format=500w[/img]

And to make dying even better (wait a second....) the chest works now! So before you go adventuring, make sure you lock up all your junk. Don't blame us if you lose your loot bag in the middle of the night and can't find it again. 

[img]https://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/56f44152c6fc0896abc34426/1458848103235/?format=500w[/img]

[h1]FULL PATCH NOTES:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Revamped the tutorial.
[*]Chest is functional now. YAY.
[*]Added loot bags on player death.
[*]Crafting can now create a stack if shift is pressed.
[*]Some crafting recipes now yield multiple items.
[*]Rebalanced crafting recipes.
[*]Increased size of vine.
[*]Corrected ruins giving the wrong stones on breaking, and increased amount given.
[*]Fixed silica and iron ore sizes.
[*]Greatly reduced trample damage.
[*]Multiple mouths now do not always all bite at once.
[*]Increased door interaction range.
[*]Fixed incorrect footstep sounds from playing.
[*]Removed scroll bars from inventory if it is not needed.
[*]Fixed bug where players could still pick up items when they do not have room.
[*]Added ability to drop an item from inventory by selecting the item and clicking off of the inventory.
[*]Fire damage removed on death.
[*]Fixed bug where alive creature’s parts were being highlighted.
[*]Added message to loading screen.
[*]Added creature eggs to the environment.
[*]Added more silica ore to the environment.
[/list]

Here's a Team CHKN selfie and Kate with the guys from [url=http://www.butterscotch-shenanigans.com/]Butterscotch Shenanigans[/url]! They were hilarious and said CHKN would do great. 

[img]https://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/56f44085c6fc0896abc33d99/56f44085f8baf3dafda6509f/1458847925168/Team+Photo.JPG?format=500w[/img]

[img]https://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/56f44085c6fc0896abc33d99/56f44085cf80a16f3fdac911/1458847880139/Butterscotch+Shenanigans.JPG?format=500w[/img]

notes.title: Dev Log & Patch Notes for Beta Tester Version 0.0.9
notes.content:
[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/56e88aaf45bf21828329d407/1458080454725/?format=1000w[/img]

John has worked continuously on networking every aspect of the game, and today we have an early (key word, early) version of multiplayer to the closed beta testers. It's a first pass at it and it will be buggy, but this is huge step. We more than doubled the size of our map in only a few months, and one poor soul (John) is networking that whole map. Let's all send him good vibes! He's awesome!

Roman is having another go at the onboarding. We got a lot of feedback from our last wave of beta testing, so Roman is taking those nuggets of knowledge and beginning to apply them to the game.

Greg has gotten super close on fixing the chunk loading. It may only drop a few frames, at the most, but it has been greatly improved. He is working out some kinks this week.

Along with that, we debugged the save/load feature that was giving a lot of people problems. There may be a few minor issues, but it is much better. Turns out the other minor bugs were sabotaging the save/load function.

We have dealt with most of them...  

[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/56e88e34f8baf30da13895b1/1458081335223/?format=500w[/img]

PATCH NOTES:
[list] 
[*]Reenabled multiplayer
[*]Debugged Load/Save
[*]Angular fish lure can now be harvested
[*]Optimizations[/list]

notes.title: 5 Things to Know About Creature Emotions.
notes.content:
[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/56e079397c65e437a0525ae8/1457551678193/?format=1000w[/img]

In CHKN your creatures become tools as much as your generic hatchet or axe would. In fact, hatchets don't work as well in breaking down trees or rocks as much as a creatures mouth would. You are then encouraged to utilize your creatures with the whistle in order to help you survive and thrive.

So where do you start? You need to understand the creatures and their emotions first because without a tamed creature, you can't use them in the first place. Here we outline a few things in order to understand your creatures emotions.

[h1]1. Creatures have five emotions (currently). [/h1]
[list][*]NEUTRAL: When you make a creature, they start out as neutral. They require food and attention in order to move on to feeling happy.
[*]HAPPY: Creatures actively pursue play. They follow you closely, eyes wide and mouth smiling, staying sometimes annoyingly close to you (like a puppy who is excited you are home.)
[*]ANGRY: Wild creatures can be angry depending on the makeup of their blocks. They may attack if you come too close to them. Tamed creatures can also turn angry as well.
[*]SCARED: Once scared, creatures run away from the threat and won't slow down until they become calm on their own, then (if you made the effort to chase them down) you can pet or feed them to make them happy again.
[*]SAD: Sad creatures look at the ground, walk slowly and clearly look sad with a grown and down-turned eyebrows. This emotion usually takes time to happen. [/list]

[h1]2. Each emotion has certain triggers.[/h1]
[list]
[*]Creatures require attention: That includes petting, eating, playing and generally spending time together. If you don't do these things, after a while creatures may become sad. 
[*]Losing a friend: Creatures are aware of other creatures around them and if one dies or becomes scared, they know and will feel sad or scared because of it. 
[*]Starvation: If creatures aren't fed they will become sad and lethargic. If you neglect them enough they may die of starvation.
[*]Damage and Aggression: In any form, whether you attack them or another creature does, damage will cause a creature to become angry and attack back, and then eventually scared (if you don't kill them first).[/list]

[h1]3. Tame creatures can be used to your advantage.[/h1]
[list]
[*]Creatures become tame after they have been given enough food and attention. You can tame wild or freshly made creatures, but you can only edit creatures that you have made in the first place. They are a little bit more accepting of you than wild creatures.
[*]Only tame creatures can be used to break down resources, be ridden and protect your homestead.
[*]You can use your whistle to command your tamed companion to break down stones and tress as well as attack other threatening creatures.
[*]You can ride tamed creatures in order to get around the large environment faster.
[*]Tame creatures who lay eggs will let you harvest them for life blocks, like when you make a farm of creatures.[/list]

[h1]4. You can tell how creatures feel by their facial expressions, sounds and body language.[/h1]
[list]
[*]Just like the picture of the dragon above, creatures show their emotion through their facial expressions, especially their eyebrows. 
[*]Happy creatures have excited facial expressions and move quickly and excitedly. They also coo.
[*]Sad creatures move slow and look down at the ground, not at you. 
[*]Scared creatures have surprised, wide eyes and high-arched eyebrows. They may scream.
[*]Angry creatures snarl and bare their teeth, as well as furrow their eyebrows.[/list]

[h1]5.  These emotions effect the way you play the game.[/h1]
[list]
[*]Not all creatures are alike. Some creatures might take more time and energy to tame them, some are more aggressive and some may become more easily scared than others. It all depends on their lifeblock combination. 
[*]You must work with your creature and learn how they are feeling in order to use them to your advantage. If your creature becomes scared or angry, you must solve this problem in order to complete whatever goal you had in mind. [/list]

[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/56e08ff707eaa058bdafded5/1457557502102/?format=500w[/img]

[h1]1. Creatures have five emotions (currently). [/h1]
[list][*]NEUTRAL: When you make a creature, they start out as neutral. They require food and attention in order to move on to feeling happy.
[*]HAPPY: Creatures actively pursue play. They follow you closely, eyes wide and mouth smiling, staying sometimes annoyingly close to you (like a puppy who is excited you are home.)
[*]ANGRY: Wild creatures can be angry depending on the makeup of their blocks. They may attack if you come too close to them. Tamed creatures can also turn angry as well.
[*]SCARED: Once scared, creatures run away from the threat and won't slow down until they become calm on their own, then (if you made the effort to chase them down) you can pet or feed them to make them happy again.
[*]SAD: Sad creatures look at the ground, walk slowly and clearly look sad with a grown and down-turned eyebrows. This emotion usually takes time to happen. [/list]

[h1]2. Each emotion has certain triggers.[/h1]
[list]
[*]Creatures require attention: That includes petting, eating, playing and generally spending time together. If you don't do these things, after a while creatures may become sad. 
[*]Losing a friend: Creatures are aware of other creatures around them and if one dies or becomes scared, they know and will feel sad or scared because of it. 
[*]Starvation: If creatures aren't fed they will become sad and lethargic. If you neglect them enough they may die of starvation.
[*]Damage and Aggression: In any form, whether you attack them or another creature does, damage will cause a creature to become angry and attack back, and then eventually scared (if you don't kill them first).[/list]

[h1]3. Tame creatures can be used to your advantage.[/h1]
[list]
[*]Creatures become tame after they have been given enough food and attention. You can tame wild or freshly made creatures, but you can only edit creatures that you have made in the first place. They are a little bit more accepting of you than wild creatures.
[*]Only tame creatures can be used to break down resources, be ridden and protect your homestead.
[*]You can use your whistle to command your tamed companion to break down stones and tress as well as attack other threatening creatures.
[*]You can ride tamed creatures in order to get around the large environment faster.
[*]Tame creatures who lay eggs will let you harvest them for life blocks, like when you make a farm of creatures.[/list]

[h1]4. You can tell how creatures feel by their facial expressions, sounds and body language.[/h1]
[list]
[*]Just like the picture of the dragon above, creatures show their emotion through their facial expressions, especially their eyebrows. 
[*]Happy creatures have excited facial expressions and move quickly and excitedly. They also coo.
[*]Sad creatures move slow and look down at the ground, not at you. 
[*]Scared creatures have surprised, wide eyes and high-arched eyebrows. They may scream.
[*]Angry creatures snarl and bare their teeth, as well as furrow their eyebrows.[/list]

[h1]5.  These emotions effect the way you play the game.[/h1]
[list]
[*]Not all creatures are alike. Some creatures might take more time and energy to tame them, some are more aggressive and some may become more easily scared than others. It all depends on their lifeblock combination. 
[*]You must work with your creature and learn how they are feeling in order to use them to your advantage. If your creature becomes scared or angry, you must solve this problem in order to complete whatever goal you had in mind. [/list]

[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/56e08ff707eaa058bdafded5/1457557502102/?format=500w[/img]

notes.title: Dev Log: Sheep, Destruction and Onboarding.
notes.content:
Team CHKN is growing! We have three new people on our team now, all working on different projects. Let's see what everyone is up to.

Ashley has joined Kevin in the art department and is drawing up concepts for some new creatures. So far she has made llamas and sheep!

[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/56d59de986db4336abe24e28/1456840174058/?format=1000w[/img]

Greg is our newest engineer and he is helping John and Roman with some development. He is also working improving load times and general game speed. 

On the analytics side, we have Saarim who is our newest intern. He is analyzing the analytics but on the external side of the game, like how you answer our Beta Tester questionnaire and how often you are playing CHKN!

Phil is working on making another one of those awesome tutorials explaining the new features that will be available for Early Access. WHAT? You missed the first three?? Well, you better [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLl-hadC10Uzfc6RNykSGv6gaa993KgS_b]click on this link[/url] and go watch them! 

Kevin is working on destruction animations for structures. He's been doing a lot of research to see how different materials break and he started implementing that into the animations in CHKN. Here is a gif to show what he came up with!

[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/56d5a300746fb9758d4afd58/1456841879881/?format=500w[/img]

John is starting to work on multiplayer this week! Let's all say another prayer for him. Roman is finishing up the new tutorials. Since we added so much content, so many new items, and many new concepts, we had to redo the tutorial so you guys could learn the new Adventure Mode quickly and easily. We will be releasing the new beta tester build with this tutorial onboarding this week, so we are anxious to hear what you think!

Kate is prepping everything for the Early Access release and continuing to keep you guys happy and show you guys all this content we are cranking out!

notes.title: Horseman, the sympathetic body guard.
notes.content:
First of all, can we take a minute to realize how two horse legs and horse body block make the perfect butt cheeks?

[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/56d497a345bf21a630f0cab6/1456773553539/?format=750w[/img]

Anyway. When you're playing in Adventure Mode, you take what you can get. If you kill a chicken and a dog and break open an Octocrab egg, you will have to make do with the parts you are given. Unlike creative mode, you most likely won't be able to build a perfectly symmetrical creature. Body blocks may have to be used for heads. You might have three legs instead of four. But that's ok! I actually think they look awesome, like a rag-tag team of misfits:

[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/56d49a58b6aa60b1224c24bc/1456773736232/?format=1000w[/img]

Yesterday Roman made Horseman, a super fast, one eyed, six beaked creature with dog legs for arms (making him look humanoid). Having six beaks made him really powerful, and his horse legs made him fast! Those chickens were no match for him. However, when Horseman annihilated his first victim, he fell to his knees in grief. I don't think Horseman knew his own strength!

[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/56d49b5acf80a1c1b8878a84/1456774298669/?format=500w[/img]

notes.content:
[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/56d0d73dd210b84fb4623237/1456527215512/?format=500w[/img]
Don't edit untamed creatures anymore! They don't like that.

[h1]Today we released a build to the Beta Testers. Here are the patch notes:[/h1]

(If you aren't a beta tester, these are still great notes to read so you know what will be included in the Early Access launch.)
[list]
[*] Untamed creatures cannot be modified.
[*]Fixed regression bug with creature’s necks.
[*]Breakable objects and tree blocks now shake when damaged.
[*]Added the whistle.  The whistle allows to control a creature.  Single left click to call attention and follow, double click to go to position, right click to attack.
[*]Additional wild creatures added to adventure mode.
[*]Egg tiers added.  The more powerful the creature the harder the egg’s shell.
[*]Stomach grumble sounds added when hungry.
[*]Exploding fruit removed from trees (now a rare item that needs to be crafted).
[*]Hunger healed, damage done, and durability attributes added to many items.
[*] There is now an algorithm to determine creature bite damage.  Larger creatures now have bonuses. More aggressive creature non-mouth life blocks also add to the bonus.
[*]Final environment to be used for early access created.
[*] Balancing to all life block stats.
[*]AI aggression balanced.
[*]Fix to AI fleeing.
[*]Creatures now walk around trees.
[*]Fix to creature oversteering.[/list]

notes.title: Attack of the One-Footed Chickens: Herd Dynamics and Egg Hunting
notes.content:
[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/56d07f7d62cd94f6136e1ed8/1456504706585/?format=1000w[/img]

One of the things we are trying to convey through CHKN is how similar some of the features are to real life; emotional responses, hunger and survival, bonding with your creature, your creature protecting you, etc. 

Another way, which is a new feature we are adding for Early Access, is creature interaction with other creatures, specifically with herd dynamics. Egg Hunting is a new feature as well, and as you explore this huge new world, you will come across eggs in the wild. This will be your first opportunity to find life blocks without necessarily killing for it. 

However, there's a catch. The eggs are usually guarded by a herd of the same creature. If you break open that egg, they will come after you as one herd! You can run, but if they are fast you may not outrun them. If you are just starting out and have no weapons, you may not be able to fight either.

Check out this video below of when Roman tried to take an egg! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZN3eqBgn7QY

notes.title: Meet the latest wild creatures!
notes.content:
You're walking down a river, giant cliffs on either side of you. You hear strange sounds coming from up stream, some kind of weird hissing/chomping. Curious, you run towards the sound and into a grove of trees! But there is nothing there. *sigh* You turn around to go back upstream and you are face to face with.....

[h1]A RAMITURTLE!! AAAAAAHHH!!!![/h1]

[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/56cdf850c2ea510fbd51aa89/1456339053080/?format=1000w[/img]

But there isn't just one. Not even two. There are THREE and they are guarding an egg! What do you do? Sneak through, break the egg and run? Come back with a more powerful creature? Hide behind a tree and observe? ATTACK FULL FORCE?

[list] 
[*]Calling a creature to you (left click once facing the creature).

[*]Attack! (aim at another creature and right click).
[/list]

notes.title: A herd of Octocrabs spotted roaming the forests!!
notes.content:
[img]https://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/56cca6832eeb8126449cf2c6/1456254030394/?format=750w[/img]

Exploring in CHKN can turn into a National Geographic episode from time to time. The new environment is huge compared to the pen in the demo. There are beaches, mountains, forests and prairies, and there is much to discover! 

When the sun starts to set, little lights may appear in the distance (or close by in which case, AAAAHHH!) It's a herd of Octocrabs, and they are equipped with Anglerfish Lures to light their way in the night. They travel in packs and protect their eggs, so be careful!

[b]Dev Tip[/b]: When you are in Adventure Mode and you are hunting for creature parts to make your first creature, chop down some Exploding Fruit Trees. Take the exploding fruit and find one of these herds. You can either attack them for their parts, crack open their eggs for parts, or (if you have enough food) tame them so you can use them to help you explore in the night!

notes.title: The nights are scary. Build a creature to keep you safe!
notes.content:
[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/56cb362c4c2f85414d57a1b5/1456158484692/?format=1000w[/img]

There are many ways to create light in CHKN; torches, lanterns, stoves and campfires. [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0EfLS8l1bwI]They can be quite dangerous sometimes[/url], so if you want a better way go adventuring in the dark, consider building a creature equipped to roam the wild at night!

The Anglerfish Lure adds just enough light so you can see your creatures and your surroundings. I made Turtle Man the other day just as it was getting a little too dark to see, so I popped an anglerfish lure on his head!

Some people take it to the extreme though. One time, [url=http://chkngame.com/communitynews/2016/1/13/one-fan-creates-stories-to-go-along-with-his-creatures]a player made an entire lamp out of anglerfish lures in the demo[/url]. What do you prefer; torches or anglerfish lures for light? Tell us in the comments!

notes.title: CHKN FAQ'S
notes.content:
We get asked a lot of questions about CHKN, so here is a one-stop doc to answer your Frequently Asked Questions!

[h1]1. What operating systems is CHKN for?[/h1]
Windows, Mac and Linux.

[h1]2. What are the minimum specs required to run CHKN?[/h1]
Windows XP SP2+, Mac OS X 10.8+, Ubuntu 12.04+
Graphics card: DX9 (shader model 2.0) capabilities; generally everything made since 2004 should work.
Space: At least 1.0 GB 

[h1]3. Will CHKN be free?[/h1]
No, it will not be free. We have added a ton of content since the demo, and we will be pricing the game very farely.

[h1]4. What is the story of CHKN?[/h1]
There is no storyline; you make your own adventure! You can choose to be a peaceful farmer or a brave adventurer. You can make a zoo of creatures or go creature hunting! The possibilities are endless. 

[h1]5. Why is it named CHKN?[/h1]
It was one of the funnier images from the concept art that we couldn’t get out of our heads and then we just knocked out all the vowels. 

[h1]6. Will CHKN be coming to other platforms, like mobile and console?[/h1]
Yes, but not right away. We are focusing on Steam first, and then we will be moving to other platforms. 

[h1]7. What do I get by buying CHKN on Early Access?[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Over 80 life blocks and over 170 items total.
    [*]A vast environment to explore, with mountains, grasslands, and beaches.
    [*]The ability to create creatures, build structures, craft items and farm.
[*] A small version of Multiplayer; create and play with friends!
[/list]

Did we miss something? Comment below and we will add it to the FAQ'S!

notes.title: The Adventures of Cactus Man!
notes.content:
While testing the game, Kate accidentally made our new favorite creature; Cactus Man. He has unofficially become our mascot. 

[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/56ab9ff73c44d83fc74ae26c/1454088191435/?format=1000w[/img]

Every day we discover something new and more often than not, we burst out laughing at our computers. Kate was just going to make a cactus but then decided to give it eyes and a mouth, and what happened she did NOT expect.

Cactus Man was born!

Cactus Man was very tempermental. After leaving the build sphere he immediately chased after Kate with his super fast horse legs, spinning in circles and farting, glaring menacingly at Kate.

Kate had to hover to get out of his reach, and when she did Cactus Man immediately became distracted by a ball of fluff that she had knocked off of him while editing (he didn't look good with hair. Dinosaus spikes were better!)

[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/56aba00d3c44d83fc74ae357/1454088226209/?format=1000w[/img]

After a few burgers and burps, Cactus Man decided to go for a swim but stopped in the shallows, looking longingly into the ocean. Probably contemplating life and his purpose. 

[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/56aba056a12f44996159a4c6/1454088493106/?format=1000w[/img]

[h1]TELL US IN THE COMMENTS WHAT YOU THINK HIS PURPOSE SHOULD BE! 
And follow us to stay up to date with Cactus Man's adventures. [/h1]

notes.title: Dev Log #1: What is the team doing this week?
notes.content:
[h1]Hello CHKN Army! How is everyone doing?[/h1]

Welcome to our Steam Page! We just recently opened it for Pre-Release and we can't wait to start talking to you guys. 

We have a big announcement today; we are only a few weeks away from launching on Early Access, and in preparation we are going to be doing two, count em TWO Dev Logs per week. One at the beginning to let you know what’s in store for the week, and one at the end to let you know what we accomplished! WOOHOO, EFFICIENCY! 

[i]So what is everyone working on this week?[/i]

John is adding a few extra things to the current build that we released last week to the beta testers. This will include sling shot and blow dart animations as well as the crafting recipes to make them. He will also be making sure the chest and whistle work by the next build. 

Basically he will be wrapping up all the final touches, like making sure new players are easily introduced to the game and not thrown head long into the mayhem. He will also be working on the final environment (the one that is in the beta currently is just a test environment.)

Let’s all say a prayer for John.

Roman is changing up the tutorial to be more accurate to all the new content we added. He’s going to make sure it’s easy for you guys to learn adventure mode, since we have added a TON of stuff since the last demo release.

Kate is working on spreading the Word of CHKN across all the lands. 

And Kevin, who I haven’t seen in person for a very long time (he may have been abducted by our robot overlords and replaced by a machine) is working on something that has come highly requested. A DRAGON! Check out the preliminary screenshots below! 

[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/56c23d49a3360ca50198c853/1455570265393/1.png?format=1000w[/img]

[img]http://static1.squarespace.com/static/55c12454e4b0ea0e6b30c89f/t/56c23d66cf80a18166b413b8/1455570285981/?format=1000w[/img]

We also created a lot of content this week, including a Let’s Play, a demo, and the Official Early Access Trailer! So get watchin! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5EAcF-2Te8U

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Wu40YcCt9Wo

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=euebLsjE5rs
